a: Lechaspanita, vechillufa sakkanta.

Challa lesibbure, umonine letaanita, vechillufa sakkanta. tachle vesibbura sakkanta, ishshata vesibbura sakkanta, keev ena vesibbure sakkanta. sheni laddag dam, sheni laddam dag, shelishi lo sakkanta.

Tanu rabbanan: hammakkiz dam lo yochal 313 — lo chalav, velo gevina, velo betzalim, velo shachalayim. im achal, amar abbaye: nayyte reviata dechalla ureviata dechamra, unearbevinhu bahade hadade venishte. vechi mippene — la mippene ella lemizrachah shel ir, mishshum dekashe recha.
Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: maalin unekle beshabbat. may unekle? amar rabbi abba: istumecha delibba. may asuta? mayyte kammona kervayyay veninya veagdana vetzitri veavdata.
Lelibba bechamra, vesimanach "veyayin yesammach levav enosh". lerucha bemayya, vesimanach "veruach elohim merachefet al pene hammayim". lechuda beshichra, vesimanach "vechaddah al shichmah".

Rav acha bereh derava shachek lehu lechullehu bahade hadade, veshakel leh mele chamesh etzbeateh, veshate leh. rav ashe shachek kol chad vechad lechodeh, veshakel mele etzbeeh rabbati umele etzbeeh zutarti. amar rav pappa: ana avadi lechol hane vela ittassay, ad daamar li hahu tayyaya: ayyti kuza chadta umalleyeh mayya, uremi beh tarvavda deduvesha ditle le be chochve, velimchar ishti. avadi hachi veittassay.

Tanu rabbanan: shishsha devarim merappein et hachole mecholyo urefuatan refua, veellu hen: keruv, uteradin, ume sisin (yevesha vekevat) [yeveshin vekeva], veheret, veyoteret hakkaved. veyesh omrim: af dagim ketannim, vela od, ella sheddagim ketannim mafrin umarbin kol gufo shel adam.

Asara devarim machzirin et hachole lecholyo, vecholyo kashe, ellu hen: haochel besar shor, shomen, besar tzali, besar tzipporim, uvetza tzeluya, veshachalayim, vetiglachat, umerchatz, ugevina, vechaved. veyesh omrim: af egozim. veyesh omrim: af kishshuin. tana deve rabbi yishmael: lamma nikra sheman kishshuin? mippene shehen kashin lechol gufo shel adam kacharavot.
Veen mistapperin mehen bechol makom. tanu rabbanan: yisrael hammistapper miggoy roe bammara, vegoy hammistapper miyyisrael, kevan shehiggia livlorito shomet et yado.

Amar mar: yisrael hammistapper miggoy roe bammara. hechi dame? i birshut harabbim, lema li mara? vei birshut hayyachid, ki roe may have? leolam birshut hayyachid, vechevan deikka mara — mitchaze keadam chashuv.
Rav chana bar bizna hava mistapper miggoy bishvile dinhardea, amar leh: chana, chana, yae koaych lezuga! amar: tete li daavari adderabbi meir.
Veadderabbanan la avar? emar daamur rabbanan birshut harabbim, birshut hayyachid mi amur? vehu savar: shevile dinhardea, kevan dishchichi rabbim, kirshut harabbim damu.
Vegoy hammistapper miyyisrael, kevan shehiggia livlorito shomet et yado. vechamma? amar rav malkiyya amar rav adda bar ahava: shalosh etzbaot lechol ruach varuach.
Amar rav chanina bereh derav ika: shappud, shefachot, vegumot — rav malkiyyo; belorit, efer mikle, ugevina — rav malkiyya.
Amar rav pappa: matnitin umatnita — rav malkiyya, shematata — rav malkiyyo, vesimanach: matnita malketa. may benayyhu? ikka benayyhu shefachot.
b: Mishna ellu devarim shel goyim asurin, veissuran issur hanaa: hayyayin, vehachometz shel goyim shehaya mittechillato yayin, vecheres haderyayni, veorot levuvin. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: bizman shehakkera shello agol — asur, mashuch — muttar.
Basar hannichnas laavoda zara — muttar, vehayyotze — asur, mippene shehu kezivche metim, divre rabbi akiva. haholchin lattarput — asur laset velatet immahen, vehabbain — muttarin.

Nodot haggoyim vekankannehen, veyayin shel yisrael kanus bahen — asurin, veissuran issur hanaa, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: en issuran issur hanaa. hachartzannim vehazzaggin shel goyim — asurin, veissuran issur hanaa, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: lachin — asurin, yeveshin — muttarin.
Hammureyays, ugevinat bet uneyayki shel goyim — asurin, veissuran issur hanaa, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: en issuran issur hanaa.
Amar rabbi yehuda: shaal rabbi yishmael et rabbi yehoshua keshehayu mehallechin badderech, amar lo: mippene ma asru gevinot goyim? amar lo: mippene shemmaamidin otah bekeva shel nevela.
Amar lo: vahalo kevat ola chamura mikkevat nevela, amru: kohen sheddato yafa sorfa chayya, velo hodu lo, aval amru: en nehenin velo moalin!
Amar lo: mippene shemmaamidin otah bekevat egle avoda zara. amar lo: im ken, lamma lo asaruha bahanaa?
Hissio ledavar acher, amar lo: yishmael, heach atta kore "ki tovim dodecha miyyayin" o "ki tovim dodayicha"?
Amar lo: "ki tovim dodayicha". amar lo: en haddavar ken, shehare chavero melammed alav: "lereach shemanecha tovim".
Gemara yayin menalan? amar rabba bar avu, amar kera: "asher chelev zevachemo yochelu yishtu yen nesicham", ma zevach asur bahanaa, af yayin name asur bahanaa.
Zevach gufeh menalan? dichtiv: "vayyitztzamdu levaal peor vayyochlu zivche metim", ma met asur bahanaa, af zevach name asur bahanaa.
Umet gufeh menalan? atya "sham" "sham" meegla arufa, ketiv hacha: "vattamot sham miryam", uchetiv hatam: "vearfu sham et haegla bannachal", ma lehallan asur bahanaa, af kan name asur bahanaa.
Vehatam menalan? amri deve rabbi yannay: "kappara" ketiv bah, kekadashim.

Vehachometz shel goyim shehaya mittechillato yayin. peshita! mishshum deachmetz peka leh issureh? amar rav ashe: ha ata leashmoinan chometz shellanu beyad goy en tzarich chotam betoch chotam. i mishshum innassoche — la menassechi, vei mishshum ichallofe — kevan deikka chotam la tarach umezayyef.

Amar rabbi ila, shaninu: yayin mevushshal shel goyim shehaya mittechillato yayin — asur. peshita! mishshum deibbashshil peka leh issureh? amar rav ashe: ha ata leashmoinan, yayin mevushshal shellanu beyad goyim en tzarich chotam betoch chotam. i mishshum innassoche — la menassechi, vei mishshum

a: Ichallofe — kevan deikka chotam echad, la tarach umezayyef.

Tanu rabbanan: yayin mevushshal vaalunetit shel goyim — asurin, alunetit kivriyyaytah — mutteret. veezo hi alunetit? keditnan gabbe shabbat: osin enomelin veen osin alunetit. veezo hi enomelin veezo hi alunetit? enomelin — yayin udevash ufilpelin, alunetit — yayin yashan umayim tzelulin vaafarsemon, deavdi leve massuta.

Rabba verav yosef deamri tarvayyhu: yayin mazug en bo mishshum gilluy, yayin mevushshal en bo mishshum nissuch. ibbaya lehu: yayin mevushshal yesh bo mishshum gilluy o en bo mishshum gilluy? ta shema: heid rabbi yaakov bar idi al yayin mevushshal sheen bo mishshum gilluy.

Rabbi yannay bar yishmael chalash, al legabbeh rabbi yishmael ben zerud verabbanan leshayyole beh. yatvi veka mibbaya lehu: yayin mevushshal, yesh bo mishshum gilluy o en bo mishshum gilluy? amar lehu rabbi yishmael ben zerud: hachi amar rabbi shimon ben lakish mishshum gavra rabba, umannu? rabbi chiyyay: yayin mevushshal en bo mishshum gilluy. amaru leh: nismoch? machve lehu rabbi yannay bar yishmael: alay veal tzavvari.
Shemuel veavlet havo yatvi, ayyto lekammayyhu chamra mevashshela, mashcheh lideh, amar leh shemuel: hare amru yayin mevushshal en bo mishshum yen nesech.

Ammeteh derabbi chiyyay iggallivyy la hahu chamra mevashshela, atay lekammeh derabbi chiyyay, amar la: hare amru yayin mevushshal en bo mishshum gilluy. shammaeh derav adda bar ahava iggalli leh chamra meziga, amar leh: hare amru yayin mazug en bo mishshum gilluy.

Amar rav pappa: la amaran ella dimzig tuva, aval mezig vela mezig shate. umezig vela mezig mi shate? veha rabba bar rav huna hava kaazel bearba, vahava naket chamra bahadeh, vechazyeh lehahu chivya detzare veate. amar leh leshammaeh: sammi eneh deden. shekel kalli mayya sheda beh, vesar laachoreh!
Achayyay masar nafsheh, ammeziga la mesar nafsheh.

Veammeziga la masar nafsheh? veha rabbi yannay hava be achbore, veamri leh: bar hedya hava be achbore, havo yatvi vahavo ka shatu chamra meziga. pash lehu chamra bechuva, utzerunehi bifronka, vechazye lehahu chivya dishkel mayya urema bechubba ad dimla bechubba, uselek chamra illave peronka veshate!
Amri: demazeg ihu shate, demazgi acharine la shate.

Amar rav ashe, veittema rav mesharsheya: peruka lesakkanta? amar rava: hilcheta — yayin mazug yesh bo mishshum gilluy, veyesh bo mishshum yen nesech; yayin mevushshal en bo mishshum gilluy, veen bo mishshum yen nesech.

Shammaeh derav chilkiyya bar tovi iggallay [leh] hahu kista demayya, vahava nayem gabba. ata legabbeh derav chilkiyya bar tovi, amar leh: hare amru "emat yashen alehen", vehane mille bimama, aval belelya — la. vela hi, la shena bimama vela shena belelya, "emat yashen alehen" la amrinan.
Rav la shate [mayya] mibbe arammaa, amar: la zehiri begilluy, mibbe armalta shate, amar: sircha degavra nekita.

Shemuel la shate mayya mibbe armalta, amar: let la emta degavra vela meychasseya mayya, aval mibbe arammaa shate. nehi deaggilluya la kafdi, ammenakkeruta miha kafdi. ikka deamri: rav la shate mayya mibbe arammaa, aval mibbe armalta shate. shemuel la shate mayya, la mibbe arammaa vela mibbe armalta.

Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: shalosh yenot hen, veen bahen mishshum gilluy, veellu hen: chad, mar, matok. chad — tila charifa dimtzare zikke, mar — yarnaka, matok — chuleya. rav chama matne leilluya: chad — chamar ufilpelin, mar — appesintin, matok — me barg.

Amar rabbi shimon ben lakish: kerina en bo mishshum gilluy. may kerina? amar rabbi avahu: chamra chalya deate measya. amar rava: uvimkomo yesh bo mishshum gilluy, may tama? chamar medina hu. amar rava: hay chamra deakrem, ad telata yome yesh bo mishshum gilluy umishshum yen nesech,
b: Mikkan veelach — en bo mishshum gilluy, veen bo mishshum yen nesech. unehardae amri: afillu levatar telata yome chayyshinan mishshum gilluy. may tama? zimnin mikkere shate.

Tanu rabbanan: yayin toses en bo mishshum gilluy, vechamma tesisato? shelosha yamim. hashshachalayim en bahem mishshum gilluy, uvene gola nahagu bahen issur. vela amaran ella delet behu challa, aval it behu challa — miggare behu.

Kuttach habbavli en bo mishshum gilluy, uvene gola nahagu bo issur. amar rav menashshe: i it beh nikkure — chayyshinan. amar rav chiyyay bar ashe amar shemuel: me tif tif en bo mishshum gilluy. amar rav ashe: vehu deaved tif lahade tif tif.

Amar rav chiyyay bar ashe amar shemuel: pi teena en bo mishshum gilluy. keman? ki hay tanna, detanya: rabbi eliezer omer: ochel adam anavim uteenim ballayla veeno choshesh, mishshum shenneemar: "shomer petaim Adonai".

Amar rav safra mishshum rabbi yehoshua daroma: shelosha mine eres hen, shel bachur — shokea, shel benoni — mefapea, veshel zaken — tzaf. lememra dichma dekashshish kechish cheleh? vehatanya: shelosha kol zeman shemmazkinin gevura mittosefet bahen, ellu hen: dag, nachash, vachazir! koach osofe hu deka mosef, zihareh kelish.

Shel bachur shokea, lemay hilcheta? detanya: chavit (shennitgalla) [shennitgalleta], af al pi sheshshatu mimmenna tisha velo metu — lo yishte mimmenna asiri. maase haya sheshshatu mimmennu tisha velo metu, veshata asiri vamet. amar rabbi yirmeya: zehu shokea.

Vechen avattiach shennitgalleta, af al pi sheachlu mimmenna tisha bene adam velo metu, lo yochal mimmenna asiri. maase haya veachlu mimmenna tisha velo metu, veachal asiri vamet. amar rabbi: zehu shokea.

Tanu rabbanan: mayim shennitgallu — hare ze lo yishpechem birshut harabbim, velo yerabbetz bahen et habbayit, velo yegabbel bahen et hattit, velo yashke mehen lo behemto velo behemat chavero, velo yirchatz bahen panav yadav veraglav. acherim omrim: makom sheyyesh sirta — asur, en sirta — muttar.
Acherim hayeynu tanna kamma! ikka benayyhu gav hayyad vegav haregel verummane deappe.

Amar mar: lo yashke mehen lo behemto velo behemat chavero. vehatanya: aval mashkehu levehemat atzmo! ki tanya hahi — leshunnara. i hachi, dechavreh name? dechavreh kachesh. dideh name kachesh? hadar bare. dechavreh name hadar bare! zimnin devae lezabbone, umafsed leh minneh.
Amar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi yehuda ben betera: shelosha yenot hen — yen nesech asur bahanaa, umetamme tumea chamura bichzayit.

a: Setam yenam — asur bahanaa, umetamme tumeat mashkin birviit. hammafkid yeno etzel goy — asur bishtiyya, umuttar bahanaa.
Vehatnan: hammafkid perotav etzel goy, hare hen keferotav shel goy lishviit ulemaaser! kegon sheyyiched lo keren zavit.
I hachi, bishtiyya name lishtere! deha rabbi yochanan ikkela lefarod, amar: kelum yesh mishnat bar kappara? tena leh rabbi tanchum demin parod: hammafkid yeno etzel goy — muttar bishtiyya.
Kare aleh "mekom sheyyippol haetz sham yehu", "sham yehu" salka datach? ella sham yehu perotav.
Amar rabbi zera: la kashya — ha rabbi eliezer, ha rabbanan.
Detanya: echad hallokeach veechad hassocher bayit bachatzero shel goy, umilleuhu yayin, umafteach o chotam beyad yisrael — rabbi eliezer mattir, vachachamim osrin.

Amar rabbi chiyyay bereh derabbi chiyyay bar nachmani, amar rav chisda amar rav, veamri la amar rav chisda amar zeeri, veamri la amar rav chisda: amar li abba bar chama, hachi amar zeeri: halacha kerabbi eliezer.

Amar rabbi elazar: hakkol mishtammer bechotam echad, chutz min hayyayin sheen mishtammer bechotam echad. verabbi yochanan amar: afillu yayin mishtammer bechotam echad. vela peligi — ha kerabbi eliezer, ha kerabbanan.

Ikka deamri, amar rabbi elazar: hakkol mishtammer bechotam betoch chotam, chutz min hayyayin sheen mishtammer bechotam betoch chotam. verabbi yochanan amar: afillu yayin mishtammer bechotam betoch chotam. vetarvayyhu kerabbanan, mar savar: ki peligi rabbanan aleh derabbi eliezer bechotam echad, aval bechotam betoch chotam sharu. umar savar: afillu chotam betoch chotam asri.

Hechi dame chotam betoch chotam? amar rava: aggana defumma dechavita sherika vachatima — have chotam betoch chotam, vei la — la. dikkula umihaddak — have chotam betoch chotam, la mihaddak — la have chotam betoch chotam. nod bedisakkayya, chatimat piv lematta — have chotam betoch chotam, piv lemala — la have chotam betoch chotam, vechi kayif pummeh legav vetzayir vachatim — have chotam betoch chotam.

Tanu rabbanan, barishona hayu omrim: yayin shel en kushi asur mippene birat serika, veshel barkata asur mippene kefar parshay, veshel zagdor asur mippene kefar shalem. chazru lomar: chaviyyot petuchot asurot, setumot muttarot.
Meikkara may sevur, ulevassof may sevur? meikkara sevur: en kuti makpid al magga goy, la shena petuchot vela shena setumot. ulevassof sevur: ki la kafed appetuchot, assetumot mikpayd kafed.
Usetumot muttarot? ureminhi:
b: Hashsholeach chavit shel yayin beyad kuti, veshel tzir veshel mureyays beyad goy, im makkir chotamo usetamo — muttar, im lav — asur!
Amar rabbi zera: la kashya — kan bair, kan badderech.
Matkef la rabbi yirmeya: midde hanach deir la bederech atu? ella amar rabbi yirmeya: ben haggittot shaninu, kevan dechulle alma afchi, mirtat, amar: hasheta i chazu li mafsedu li.
Ittemar: mippene ma asru shechar shel goyim? rame bar chama amar rabbi yitzchak: mishshum chatnut, rav nachman amar: mishshum gilluy.
Aggilluy demay? illema gilluy denazyayta — anan name megallenan! veella dechavita — anan name megallenan! la tzericha, beatra dimtzallu mayya.
Ella meatta yashan tishtere! deamar rabbi: yashan muttar — en mannicho leyayshshen, hechmitz muttar — en mannicho lehachemitz. gezera yashan attu chadash.
Rav pappa mappeykin leh (laababea) [abbava] dechanuta, veshate. rav achay mayytu leh leveteh, veshate. vetarvayyhu mishshum chatnut, rav achay aved harechaka yattirta.
Rav shemuel bar bisna ikkela lemargevan, ayyto leh chamra vela ishti, ayyto leh shichra vela ishti. bishlama chamra mishshum shimtza, shichra mishshum may? mishshum shimtza deshimtza.
Amar rav: hay shichra daarammaa shere, vechiyyay beri la nishte minneh. ma nafshach? i shere — lechulle alma shere, i asir — lechulle alma asir!
Ella, rav savar mishshum gilluya, veazel merora dichshuta vekale leh zihareh, vedilke malke leh tefe, vechiyyay beri hoil uleke la nishte minneh.

Amar shemuel: kol hashsheratzim yesh lahen eres, shel nachash memit, shel sheratzim eno memit. amar leh shemuel lechiyyay bar rav: bar arya, ta veema lach milleta mealleyayta dahava amar rav avuch, hachi amar avuch: hane arammae zukane — (dahavo shatu) [mishshum deshatu] gilluya, (vela mitu) [vehay dela mayyti] — ayyeyde deachli shekatzim uremasim chavil gufayyhu.
Amar rav yosef:

a: Hay challa deshichra daarammaa asur, dimarvi beh duredya deyen nesech. amar rav ashe: umeotzar shere, kevan dimarvi beh misra sere.

Vacheres haderyayni. may haderyayni? amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: cheres shel haderyaynus kesar. ki ata rav dimi amar: karka betula hayta shello avadah adam meolam, avadah unetaah, verame leh lechamra begulefe chivvare, umayytzi lehu lechamrayyhu, umetabberu lehu bechasfe vedaru bahadayyhu, vechol hecha dematu taru lehu veshatu. amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: verishon shellanu kishlishi shellahen.
Ibbaya lehu: mahu lismoch bahen kare hammitta? rotze bekiyyumo al yede davar acher — shere o asur?
Ta shema, derabbi elazar verabbi yochanan: chad asar vechad share, vehilcheta keman deasar.

Metivi: haddardurin veharukebaot shel goyim, yayin shel yisrael kanus bahen — asur bishtiyya umuttar bahanaa. heid shimon ben gudda lifne beno shel rabban gamliel al rabban gamliel, sheshshata mimmennu beakko, velo hodu lo.
Nodot shel goyim — rabban shimon ben gamliel omer mishshum rabbi yehoshua ben kapposay: asur laasot mehen shetichin lachamor, veha hacha derotze bekiyyumo al yede davar acher, vekatane deasur!
Velitamaych, kankannim shel goyim littasru lemizban! may shena nodot umay shena kankannim? amar rava: gezera shemma yibbaka nodo veyittelennu veyitperennu al gabbe nodo.
Uleman deamar rotze bekiyyumo al yede davar acher asur, may shena kankannim dishru? amar lach: hatam leteh leissureh beeneh, hacha iteh leissureh beeneh.
Velo hodu lo. ureminhi: yayin habba berukebaot shel goyim asur bishtiyya umuttar bahanaa, heid shimon ben gudda lifne beno shel rabban gamliel al rabban gamliel sheshshata mimmennu beakko, vehodu lo!
May "lo hodu lo" dekaamar hatam? kol siato, aval beno mode leh. ibbaet ema: gudda lechod, vegudda lechod.
Veorot levuvin. tanu rabbanan: ezehu or lavuv? kol shekkarua keneged hallev vekadur kemin arubba, yesh alav koret dam — asur,
b: En alav koret dam — muttar. amar rav huna: lo shanu ella shello melacho, aval melacho — asur. ema: milcho heevirattu.
Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: bizman shehakkera shello agol — asur, mashuch — muttar. amar rav yosef, amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel.
Amar leh abbaye: halacha — mikkelal difligi? amar leh: may nafka lach minna? amar leh: gemara gemor, zemorta tehe?
Basar hannichnas laavoda zara muttar. man tanna? amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: dela kerabbi elazar, dei kerabbi elazar, haamar: setam machshevet goy laavoda zara.
Vehayyotze asur, mippene shehu kezivche metim. may tama? i efshar delekka tikrovet avoda zara. manni? rabbi yehuda ben betera hi.

Detanya: rabbi yehuda ben betira omer: minnayin letikrovet avoda zara shemmetamme beohel? shenneemar: "vayyitztzamdu levaal peor vayyochlu zivche metim", ma met metamme beohel, af tikrovet avoda zara metammea beohel.
Haholchin lattarput — asurin laset velatet immahem. amar shemuel: goy haholech lattarput, bahalicha — asur, deazel umode kamme avoda zara, bachazara — muttar, may dahava hava.
Yisrael haholech lattarput — bahalicha muttar, dilma hadar beh vela azel; bachazara asur, kevan

a: Daavik ba, mihdar hadar azel.
Vehatanya: yisrael haholech lattarput, ben bahalicha ben bachazara — asur! amar rav ashe: ki tanya hahi beyisrael meshummad, devadday azel.
Tanu rabbanan: goy haholech leyarid, ben bahalicha ben bachazara — muttar. yisrael haholech leyarid, bahalicha — muttar, bachazara — asur.
May shena yisrael devachazara asur? deamri: avoda zara zabben, deme avoda zara ikka bahadeh. goy name nema: avoda zara zabben, deme avoda zara ikka bahadeh!
Ella goy, amrinan: gelima zabben, chamra zabben; yisrael name nema: emor gelima zabben, chamra zabben! i ita dahava leh hacha, hava mezabben leh.
Vehabbain muttarin. amar rabbi shimon ben lakish: lo shanu ella sheen keshurin ze baze, aval keshurin ze baze — asurin, ema dato lachzor.

Nodot haggoyim vekankannehem. tanu rabbanan: nodot haggoyim, gerudim chadashim — muttarin, yeshanim umezuppafin — asurin. goy ribbevan veibbedan venatan letochan yayin, veyisrael omed al gabbav — eno choshesh.

Vechi meachar degoy noten letochan yayin, ki yisrael omed al gabbav may have? amar rav pappa: hachi kaamar — goy ribbevan veibbedan, veyisrael noten letochan yayin, veyisrael acher omed al gabbav veeno choshesh.
Umeachar deyisrael noten letochan yayin, yisrael acher omed al gabbav lema li? dilma aggav tirdeh menassech, velav addateh.
Rav zevid amar: leolam kidkaamrat meikkara, vehacha beiddana deka shade leh naase kezorek mayim letit. amar rav pappe: shema minna midderav zevid, hay goy dishda chamra leve milche deyisrael — shere.
Matkef la rav ashe: mi dame? hatam kaazel leibbud, hacha la kaazel leibbud.

Bar adi tayyaya anas hanhu zike merav yitzchak bar yosef, rema behu chamra veahderinhu nihaleh, ata sheel be midresha. amar leh rabbi yirmeya: kach hora rabbi amme halacha lemaase — memallean mayim shelosha yamim umearan. veamar rava: tzarich learan meet leet.

Sevur minna: hane mille didan, aval didhu — la. ki ata ravin amar rabbi shimon ben lakish: echad shellanu veechad shellahem. sevar rav acha bereh derava kammeh derav ashe lememar: hane mille nodot, aval kankannim — la. amar leh rav ashe: la shena nodot vela shena kankannim.

Tanu rabbanan: kankannim shel goyim, chadashim gerudim — muttarin, yeshanim umezuppafin — asurin. goy noten letochan yayin — yisrael noten letochan mayim, goy noten letochan yayin — yisrael noten letochan tzir umureyays, veeno choshesh.
Ibbaya lehu:
b: Lechattechilla o diavad? ta shema, detane rav zevid bar oshaya: hallokeach kankannim min haggoyim — chadashim noten letochan yayin, yeshanim — noten letochan tzir umureyays lechattechilla.

Bea minneh rabbi yehuda nesia merabbi amme: hechziran lechivshan haesh venitlabbenu, mahu? amar leh: tzir soref, ur lo kol shekken?! ittemar name: amar rabbi yochanan, veamri la amar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan: kankannim shel goyim shehechziran lechivshan haesh, kevan shennashra ziftan mehen — muttarin.
Amar rav ashe: la tema ad denatran, ella afillu refay mirfa, af al gav dela netar. kinsa — peligi ba rav acha veravina, chad asar vechad share, vehilcheta keman deasar.

Ibbaya lehu: mahu litten letocho shechar? rav nachman verav yehuda asri, verava share. ravina shera leh lerav chiyyay bereh derav yitzchak lemirma beh shichra, azal rema beh chamra, vaafillu hachi la chash la lemilleta, amar: akray bealma hu.

Rav yitzchak bar bisna hava leh hanhu mane defakusena, mallinhu mayya, annechinhu beshimsha, pekau. amar leh rabbi abba: asartinhu alach issura dilalam. emor daamur rabbanan memallinhu mayya, annoche beshimsha mi amur?
Amar rabbi yosna amar rabbi amme: kele neter en (lo) [lahen] tohora olamit. may kele neter? amar rabbi yose bar avin: kele machporet shel tzerif.
Deve parzak rufila anas hane kuve mippumebdita, rema behu chamra, ahderinhu nihalayyhu. ato shayylu lerav yehuda, amar: davar sheen machniso lekiyyum hu, meshachshechan bemayim vehen muttarin.

Amar rav avvira: hane chatzve shechime daarammae, kevan dela bali tuva — meshachshechan bemayim umuttarin. amar rav pappi: hane patvavta deve michse, kevan dela bali tuva — meshachshechan bemayim umuttarin.
Kase — rav assi asar, verav ashe shere. i shate behu goy paam rishon — kulle alma la peligi daasir, ki peligi befaam sheni.
Ikka deamri: paam rishon vesheni — kulle alma la peligi daasir, ki peligi befaam shelishi. vehilcheta: paam rishon vesheni — asur, shelishi — muttar.

Amar rav zevid: hay mane dekuneya, chivvara veukkama — shere, yeroka — asir, mishshum demitztzerif. vei it behu kartufane — kullehu asiri. daresh marimar: kuneya, ben ukkama ben chivvara ben yeroka — shere.

May shena mechametz bappesach, divo minneh mimmarimar: hane mane dekuneya, mahu leishtammoshe behu befischa? yerukke la tibbee lach, demitztzarfi uvali vaasiri. ki tibbee lach — chivvare veukkame may?
Ki it behu kartufane, la tibbee lach, devadday bali vaasiri. ki tibbee lach — deshii may? amar

a: Lehu: ana chazena lehu demiddayyeyti, vechevan demiddayyeyti vadday bali vaasiri. may tama? hattora heida al keli cheres sheeno yotze mide dofno leolam.
May shena miyyayin nesech, dedaresh lehu marimar: kullehu mane dekuneya shere?
Vechi tema: chametz deorayyta, yen nesech derabbanan — veha kol detakkun rabbanan keen deorayyta takkun! ze tashmisho bechammin, veze tashmisho betzonen.

Rabbi akiva ikkela leginzak, beo minneh: mitannin leshaot o en mitannin leshaot? la hava bideh. kankannim shel goyim asurin o muttarin? la hava bideh. bamme shimmesh moshe kol shivat yeme hammilluim? la hava bideh.

Ata sheel be midresha, amri: hilcheta mitannin leshaot, veim hishlim — mitpallel tefillat taanit. vehilcheta kankannim shel goyim leachar shenem asar chodesh muttarin. bamme shimmesh moshe shivat yeme hammilluim? bechaluk lavan. rav kahana matne: bechaluk lavan sheen bo immera.

Hachartzannim vehazzaggim shel goyim vechulei. tanu rabbanan: hachartzannim vehazzaggim shel goyim, lachin — asurin, yeveshim — muttarim. he ninhu lachin vehe ninhu yeveshin? amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: lachin — kol shenem asar chodesh, yeveshim — leachar shenem asar chodesh.
Ittemar, amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: keshehen asurin — asurin afillu bahanaa, keshehen muttarin — muttarin afillu baachila.
Amar rav zevid: hay duredyya dechamra daarammae, batar teresar yarche shatta share. amar rav chaviva bereh derava: hane gulefe, batar teresar yarche shatta share. amar rav chaviva: hane
b: Avatta detayyaye, batar teresar yarche shatta shere. amar rav acha bereh derav ika: hane puretzane daarammae, batar teresar yarche shatta share. amar rav acha bereh derava: hane gulefe shechime veukkame, batar teresar yarche shatta shere.
Vehammureyays. tanu rabbanan: mureyays umman — muttar. rabbi yehuda ben gamliel omer mishshum rabbi chanina ben gamliel: af chilak umman — muttar.

Tane avimi bereh derabbi avahu: mureyays umman muttar. hu tane la vehu amar la: paam rishon vesheni muttar, shelishi asur. may tama? paam rishon vesheni dinfish shumenayyhu — la tzerich lemirme behu chamra, mikkan veelach ramu behu chamra.

Hahu arba demureyysa daatay linmela deakko, otev rabbi abba demin akko natore bahada. amar leh rava: ad haiddana man natra? amar leh: ad haiddana (leman) [lemay] nechush la? i mishshum dimarvi beh chamra — kista demureyays beluma, kista dechamra bearbea lume.
Amar leh rabbi yirmeya lerabbi zera: dilma ayyeyde detzor ato deshave chamra? amar leh: hatam ikkule ufashore ikka.

Ugevinat bet uneyayke. amar rabbi shimon ben lakish: mippene ma asru gevinat uneyayke? mippene sherov agalim shel otah ir nishchatin laavoda zara. may irya rov agalim? afillu miut name, deha rabbi meir chayesh lemiuta!
I amrat rov — ikka miut.
Ella i amrat miut, kevan deikka rov agalim deen nishchatin laavoda zara, veikka name shear behemot deen nishchatin laavoda zara — have leh miuta demiuta, umiuta demiuta la chayesh rabbi meir.
Amar leh rabbi shimon bar elyakim lerabbi shimon ben lakish: ki nishchatin laavoda zara may have? veha at hu deshare!
Deittemar: hashshochet et habbehema lizrok damah laavoda zara, lehaketir chelbah laavoda zara, rabbi yochanan amar: asura, kasavar mechashshevin meavoda laavoda, veyalfinan chutz mippenim.
Verabbi shimon ben lakish amar: mutteret!
Amar leh: tirminach shatach, beomer: bigmar zevicha hu ovdah.

Amar rabbi yehuda: shaal rabbi yishmael. amar rav achadvuy amar rav: hamekaddesh beferesh shor hanniskal — mekuddeshet, beferesh egle avoda zara — enah mekuddeshet. ibbaet ema sevara, veibbaet ema kera.
Ibbaet ema sevara: gabbe egle avoda zara nicha leh benifcheh, aval gabbe shor hanniskal la nicha leh benifcheh.
Ibbaet ema kera: ketiv hacha: "la yidbak beyadcha meuma", uchetiv hatam: "sakol yissakel hashshor velo yeachel et besaro", besaro asur, ha pirsho mutteret.
Amar rava: tarvayyhu tenanhi, middekaamar leh: mippene shemmaamidin bekevat nevela, veka mahdar leh: vahalo kevat ola chamura mikkevat nevela.

a: Mikkelal deissure hanaa sharu pirshayyhu.
Umiddekaamar leh mippene shemmaamidin otah bekevat egle avoda zara, veka mahdar leh: im ken lamma lo asaruha bahanaa — mikkelal daavoda zara asir pirshayyhu.
Velahdar leh, mishshum deleteh leissura beeneh!
Deha mureyays, lerabbanan dela asru bahanaa, may tama? lav mishshum deleteh leissura beeneh?
Amri: hacha, kevan deokome ka mokem, chashiv leh keman deiteh leissureh beeneh.

Hissio ledavar acher vechulei. may "ki tovim dodecha miyyayin"? ki ata rav dimi amar: amra keneset yisrael lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: ribbono shel olam, arevim alay divre dodecha yoter miyyenah shel tora.

May shena hay kera deshayyleh? amar rabbi shimon ben pazzi, veittema rabbi shimon bar amme: meresheh dikra kaamar leh, "yishshakeni minneshikot pihu". amar leh: yishmael achi, chashok siftotecha zo bazo veal tibbahel lehashiv.
May tama? amar ulla, veittema rav shemuel bar abba: gezera chadasha hi, veen mefakpekin ba. may gezerta? amar rabbi shimon ben pazzi amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: mishshum nikkur.
Velema leh mishshum nikkur! kidulla, deamar ulla: ki gazri gezerta bemareva la megallu tama ad teresar yarche shatta, dilma ikka inish dela sevira leh veate lezalzole ba.
Megaddef ba rabbi yirmeya: ella meatta, yevesha tishtere, yashan tishtere! deamar rabbi chanina: yavesh muttar, en mannicho leyabbesh, yashan muttar, en mannicho leyashshen.
Amar rabbi chanina: lefi shei efshar lah belo tzichtzuche chalav, ushemuel amar: mippene shemmaamidin otah beor kevat nevela.
Ha keva gufa sharya, umi amar shemuel hachi? vehatnan: kevat haggoy veshel nevela — hare zo asura,
Vehavenan ba, attu degoy lav nevela hi?
Veamar shemuel: chada katane, kevat shechitat goy — nevela asura!
La kashya.
b: Kan kodem chazara, kan leachar chazara, umishna lo zaza mimmekomah.

Rav malkiyya mishshemeh derav adda bar ahava amar: mippene shemmachlikin paneha beshumman chazir. rav chisda amar: mippene shemmaamidin otah bechometz. rav nachman bar yitzchak amar: mippene shemmaamidin otah bisraf haorla.
Keman? ki hay tanna, detanya, rabbi eliezer omer: hammaamid bisraf haorla — asur, mippene shehu peri.
Afillu tema rabbi yehoshua, ad kan la pelig rabbi yehoshua aleh derabbi eliezer ella bekitfa digvaza, aval bekitfa defera mode.
Vehayeynu ditnan, amar rabbi yehoshua: shamati beferush, shehammaamid bisraf healin uvisraf haikkarin — muttar, bisraf happaggin — asur, mippene shehu peri.
Ben lerav chisda, ben lerav nachman bar yitzchak, tittesar bahanaa, kashya.
Darash rav nachman bereh derav chisda, may dichtiv: "lereach shemanecha tovim", lema talmid chacham dome? litzlochit shel pilyaytoyn: megulla — rechah nodef, mechussa — en rechah nodef.

Velo od, ella devarim shemmechussin mimmennu mitgallin lo, shenneemar: "alamot ahevucha", keri beh "alumot"; velo od, ella shemmalach hammavet ohavo, shenneemar: "alamot ahevucha", keri beh "al mavet"; velo od, ella shennochel shene olamot, echad haolam hazze veechad haolam habba, shenneemar: "alamot", keri beh "olamot".
Mishna veellu devarim shel goyim asurin veen issuran issur hanaa: chalav shechalavo goy veen yisrael roehu, vehappat vehashshemen shellahen. rabbi uvet dino hittiru hashshemen.

Vehashshelakot, uchevashin sheddarkan latet letochan yayin vachometz, vetarit terufa, vetzir sheen bah daga kilbit shotetet bo, vehachillek, vekoret shel chiltit, umelach selakondit — hare ellu asurin, veen issuran issur hanaa.
Gemara chalav lemay nechush la? i mishshum ichallofe — tahor chivvar, tame yarok! vei mishshum iarove — nekum! deamar mar: chalav tahor omed, chalav tame eno omed.
I deka vae ligvina, hachi name. hacha bemay askinan? deka vae leh lechamka.
Venishkol minneh kalli venekum! kevan divtahor name ikka nasyuve dela kayymi, lekka lemekam ala demilleta.
Veibbaet ema: afillu tema dekavae le ligvina, ikka dekae bene itfe.
Vehappat. amar rav kahana amar rabbi yochanan: pat lo huttera bevet din, mikkelal deikka man deshare?
In, dechi ata rav dimi amar: paam achat yatza rabbi lassade, vehevi goy lefanav pat pureni maafe sea. amar rabbi: kamma naa pat zo, ma rau chachamim leosrah? ma rau chachamim?! mishshum chatnut!
Ella, ma rau chachamim leosrah bassade. kisvurin haam hittir rabbi happat, vela hi, rabbi lo hittir et happat.

Rav yosef, veittema rav shemuel bar yehuda, amar: lo kach haya maase, ella amru: paam achat halach rabbi lemakom echad veraa pat dachuk lattalmidim, amar rabbi: en kan palter? kisvurin haam lomar palter goy, vehu lo amar ella palter yisrael.

Amar rabbi chelbo: afillu leman deamar palter goy, la amaran ella delekka palter yisrael, aval bimkom deikka palter yisrael — la. verabbi yochanan amar: afillu leman deamar palter goy, hane mille bassade, aval bair — la, mishshum chatnut.
Ayvu hava menakket veachel pat abbe mitzre, amar lehu rava, veittema rav nachman bar yitzchak: la tishtau bahadeh deayvu, dekaachel lachma daarammae.
Vehashshemen shellahen. shemen, rav amar: daniel gazar alav, ushemuel amar:

a: Zelifatan shel kelim temeim osartan. attu kulle alma ochle teharot ninhu? ella, zelifatan shel kelim asurin osartan.

Amar leh shemuel lerav: bishlama ledidi deamena zelifatan shel kelim asurin osartan, hayeynu dechi ata rav yitzchak bar shemuel bar marta veamar: daresh rabbi simlay bintzivin: shemen, rabbi yehuda uvet dino nimnu alav vehittiruhu.
Kasavar: noten taam lifgam — muttar.

Ella ledidach deamrat daniel gazar alav, daniel gezar vaata rabbi yehuda hannasi umevattel leh? vehatnan: en bet din yachol levattel divre bet din chavero, ella im ken gadol hemennu bechachma uveminyan!
Amar leh simlay luddaa ka amrat? shane luddae dimzalzelu. amar leh: eshlach leh? ikkesif.

Amar rav: im hem lo darshu, anan la darshinan? vehachtiv: "vayyasem daniyyel al libbo asher lo yitgaal befat bag hammelech uveyen mishtav" — bishte mishtaot hakkatuv medabber, echad mishte yayin veechad mishte shemen.
Rav savar: al libbo sam, ulechol yisrael hora; ushemuel savar: al libbo sam, ulechol yisrael lo hora.
Veshemen, daniel gezar? vehaamar bali avimi nivtaa mishshemeh derav: pittan veshamnan, yenan uvenotehen, kullan mishshemona asar davar hen.
Vechi tema: ata daniel gezar vela kaybul, vaato talmide dehillel veshammay ugezur vekaybul, im ken may ashaduteh derav? ella, daniel gazar alav bair, vaato inhu ugezur afillu bassade.

Verabbi yehuda hannasi hechi matze lemishre takkanta detalmide shammay vehillel? vehatnan: en bet din yachol levattel divre bet din chavero, ella im ken gadol hemennu bechachma uveminyan! veod, ha amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: bakkol yachol levattel bet din divre bet din chavero, chutz mishshemona asar davar, sheafillu yavo eliyyahu uvet dino en shomin lo!

Amar rav mesharsheya: ma taam? hoil ufashat issuro berov yisrael, shemen lo pashat issuro berov yisrael, deamar rabbi shemuel bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: yashvu rabbotenu uvadku al shemen shello pashat issuro berov yisrael, vesamchu rabbotenu al divre rabban shimon ben gamliel veal divre rabbi elazar bar tzadok, shehayu omrim: en gozrin gezera al hatztzibbur ella im ken rov tzibbur yecholin laamod bah, deamar rav adda bar ahava: may kera?
b: "Bammeera attem nearim veoti attem kovim haggoy kullo", i ikka goy kullo — in, i la — la.

Gufa, amar bali amar avimi nivtaa mishshemeh derav: pittan veshamnan, yenan uvenotehen — kullan mishshemona asar davar hen. benotehen may hi? amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: gazru al benotehen niddot mearisotan.
Ugeniva mishshemeh derav amar: kullan mishshum avoda zara gazru bahen, dechi ata rav acha bar adda amar rabbi yitzchak: gazru al pittan mishshum shamnan, may ulemeh deshemen mippat?
Ella, al pittan veshamnan mishshum yenan, veal yenan mishshum benotehen, veal benotehen mishshum davar acher, veal davar acher mishshum davar acher.
Benotehen, deorayyta hi, dichtiv: "lo titchatten bam", deorayyta shiva goyim, aval shear ummot — la, vaato inhu ugezur afillu dishar ummot.
Ulerabbi shimon ben yochay, deamar: "ki yasir et bincha meacharay" lerabbot kol hammesirot, may ikka lememar? ella deorayyta ishut derech chatnut, vaato inhu gezur afillu derech zenut.
Zenut name bevet dino shel shem gazru, dichtiv: "vayyomer yehuda hotziuha vetissaref"!
Ella, deorayyta — goy habba al bat yisrael, demashcha batreh; aval yisrael habba al haggoya — la, vaato inhu gezur afillu yisrael habba al haggoya.
Yisrael habba al haggoya — halacha lemoshe missinay hi, deamar mar: habboel arammit — kannain pogin bo.
Amar leh: deorayyta befarhesya, uchemaase shehaya, vaato inhu gezur afillu betzina. betzina name bet dino shel chashmonay gazru!
Dechi ata rav dimi amar: bet din shel chashmonay gazru, yisrael habba al haggoya chayyayv mishshum 354.
Ki ata ravin amar mishshum 360.
Ki gazru bet dino shel chashmonay bia, aval yichud la, vaato inhu gezur afillu yichud. yichud name bet dino shel david gazru!
Deamar rav yehuda: beotah shaa gazru al yichud. amri: hatam yichud devat yisrael, aval yichud degoya — la, vaato inhu gezaru afillu ayyichud degoya.

Yichud devat yisrael deorayyta hi! deamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yehotzadak: remez leyichud min hattora minnayin? shenneemar: "ki yesitcha achicha ven immecha", vechi ben em mesit, ben av eno mesit?
Ella, ben mityayched im immo, veen acher mityayched im kol arayot shebbattora!
Yichud deorayyta deeshet ish, vaata david ugezar afillu ayyichud difnuya, vaato talmide bet shammay uvet hillel gezur afillu ayyichud degoya.
May al davar acher mishshum davar acher? amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: gazru al tinok goy sheyyetamme beziva, shello yehe tinok yisrael ragil etzlo bemishkav zechur.

Deamar rabbi zera: tzaar gadol haya li etzel rabbi assi, verabbi assi etzel rabbi yochanan, verabbi yochanan etzel rabbi yannay, verabbi yannay etzel rabbi natan ben amram, verabbi natan ben amram etzel rabbi: tinok goy meematay metamme beziva? veamar li: ben yomo, ucheshebbati etzel rabbi chiyyay amar li: ben tesha shanim veyom echad.
Ucheshebbati vehirtzeti devaray lifne rabbi, amar li: hannach devaray veechoz divre rabbi chiyyay. deamar: tinok goy ematay metamme beziva — ben tesha shanim veyom echad,

a: Hoil verauy levia, metamme name beziva. amar ravina: hilkach, ha tinoket goya bat shalosh shanim veyom echad, hoil ureuya levia, metammea name beziva.
Peshita! mahu detema: hay yada leargole, veha la yada leargole? ka mashma lan.

Mistemich veazel rabbi yehuda nesia akkatpeh derabbi simlay shammaeh, amar lo: simlay, lo hayita emesh bevet hammidrash keshehittarnu et hashshemen. amar lo: beyamenu tattir af et happat! amar lo: im ken karu lan "bet dina sharya"! ditnan: heid rabbi yose ben yoezer ish tzereda al ayyayl kamtza dechan, veal mashke bet matbechayya dechan, veal deyikrav lemita mesaav, vekaru leh "yosef sharya".
Amar leh: hatam shera telat, umar shera chada, vei share mar chada achariti, akkatti tarten hu dehavyayn! amar leh: ana [name] sheray achariti. may hi?

Ditnan: ze gittich im lo bati mikkan ad shenem asar chodesh, umet betoch shenem asar chodesh — eno get, vetane ala: verabbotenu hittiruha linnase, veamrinan: man "rabbotenu"? amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: bet dina dishro mishcha.
Savri la kerabbi yose, deamar: zemanno shel shetar mochiach alav. veamar rabbi abba bereh derabbi chiyyay bar abba: rabbi yehuda hannasi hora, velo hodu lo kol sheato, veamri lah: kol siato.
Amar leh rabbi (eliezer) [elazar] lehahu sava: ki sherituha — lealtar sherituha, dela ate, o dilma leachar shenem asar chodesh, deha ikkayyaym leh tenaeh?
Vetibbee lach ammatnitin, ditnan: "hare ze gittich meachshav im lo bati mikkan ad shenem asar chodesh", umet betoch shenem asar chodesh — have get, deha ikkayyaym leh tenay.
Vetibbee lach: lealtar have gitta, deha la ata, o dilma leachar shenem asar chodesh, deha ikkayyaym leh tenaeh? in hachi name, ella mishshum dahavet behahu minyayna.
Amar abbaye: hakkol modim "lichshettetze chamma minnartikah" — lechi nafka kaamar la, vechi mayet belelya — get leachar mita hu.

"Al menat shettetze chamma minnartikah" — meachshav kaamar lah, vechi mayet belelya — ha vadday tenaa have, veget mechayyim hu, kidrav huna, deamar rav huna: kol haomer "al menat" keomer "meachshav" dame.

Lo nechleku ella beim tetze", rabbi yehuda hannasi savar la kerabbi yose, deamar: zemanno shel shetar mochiach alav, vehave leh kemehayyom im matti", kemeachshav im matti", verabbanan let lehu derabbi yose, vehave leh keze gittich im matti" gereda.

Gufa: heid yose ben yoezer ish tzereda al ayyayl kamtza dechan, veal mashke be matbechayya dechan, veal deyikrav lemita mesaav, vekaru leh "yosef sharya". may ayyayl kamtza? rav pappa amar: shoshiva, verav chiyyay bar amme mishshemeh deulla amar: susebil.
Rav pappa amar: shoshiva, vekamippalgi berosho aroch. mar savar: rosho aroch asur, umar savar: rosho aroch muttar. rav chiyyay bar amme mishshemeh deulla amar:
b: Susebil, berosho aroch — kulle alma la peligi deasur, vehacha bichnafav chofin et rubbo al yede haddechak kamippalgi: mar savar rubba kol dehu baenan, umar savar rubba deminnechar baenan.
Veal mashke be matbechayya dechan. may "dechan"? rav amar: dechan mammash, ushemuel amar: dechan milletamme acherim, aval tumeat atzman yesh bahen.
Rav amar: "dechan mammash", kasavar: tumeat mashkin derabbanan, vechi gezur rabbanan tumea bemashkin dealma, aval bemashke be matbechayya la gezaru rabbanan.

Ushemuel amar: dechan milletamme acherim, aval tumeat atzman yesh bahen, kasavar: tumeat mashkin deorayyta letamme acherim derabbanan, vechi gezaru rabbanan bemashkin dealma, bemashkin be matbechayya la gezaru.
Veal deyikrav lemita mesaav, vekaru leh "yosef sharya". "yosef asra" mibbee leh! veod, deorayyta hi, dichtiv: "vechol asher yigga al pene hassade bachalal cherev o vemet vegomer"!
Deorayyta, deyikrav — tame, deyikrav bidyikrav — tahor, vaato inhu ugezur afillu deyikrav bidyikrav, vaata ihu veokma addeorayyta.
Deyikrav bidyikrav name deorayyta hu, dichtiv: "vechol asher yigga bo hattame yitma"!

Amruha rabbanan kammeh derava, mishshemeh demar zutera bereh derav nachman, deamar mishshemeh derav nachman: deorayyta deyikrav bidyikrav, bechibburin — tumeat shiva, shello bechibburin — tumeat erev, vaato inhu ugezur afillu shello bechibburin tumeat shiva, vaata ihu veokma addeorayyta.
Deorayyta may hi? dichtiv: "hannogea bemet lechol nefesh adam vetame shivat yamim", uchetiv: "vechol asher yigga bo hattame yitma", uchetiv: "vehannefesh hannogaat titma ad haarev", ha ketzad?
Kan bechibburin, kan shello bechibburin.
Amar lehu rava: lav amena lechu la titlo beh buke serike berav nachman? hachi amar rav nachman: sefek tumea birshut harabbim hittir lahen.
Veha hilcheta missota gamrinan la, ma sota reshut hayyachid, af tumea reshut hayyachid!
Ha amar rabbi yochanan: halacha veen morin ken, vaata ihu veori leh oroye.
Tanya name hachi: rabbi yehuda omer, korot naatz lahem, veamar: ad kan reshut harabbim, ad kan reshut hayyachid. ki ato lekammeh derabbi yannay, amar lehu: ha mayya beshikata divnahara, zilu tevulu.

Vehashshelakot. menahane mille? amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: amar kera "ochel bakkesef tashbireni veachalti umayim bakkesef titten li veshatiti", kammayim — ma mayim shello nishtannu, af ochel shello nishtanna.

Ella meatta, chittin vaasaan kelayot — hachi name daasurin? vechi tema hachi name, vehatanya: chittin vaasaan kelayot — muttarin! ella, kemayim — ma mayim shello nishtannu mibberiyyaytan, af ochel shello nishtanna mibberiyyayto.

Ella meatta, chittin utechanan hachi name daasurin? vechi tema hachi name, vehatanya: chittin vaasaan kelayot, hakkemachim vehasselatot shellahen muttarin! ella kammayim — ma mayim shello nishtannu mibberiyyaytan al yede haur, af ochel shello nishtanna mibberiyyayto al yede haur.
Midde ur ketiv?

a: Ella midderabbanan, ukera asmachta bealma.

Amar rav shemuel bar rav yitzchak amar rav: kol hanneechol kemot shehu chay — en bo mishshum bishshule goyim. besura matnu hachi, befumebdita matnu hachi: amar rav shemuel bar rav yitzchak amar rav: kol sheeno neechol al shulechan melachim lelappet bo et happat — en bo mishshum bishshule goyim.
May benayyhu? ikka benayyhu: dagim ketannim, vearde, vedayysa.

Amar rav assi amar rav: dagim ketannim meluchim en bahen mishshum bishshule goyim. amar rav yosef: im tzelaan goy somech yisrael alehem mishshum eruve tavshilin, vei avdinhu goy kasa deharsana — asur.
Peshita! mahu detema: haresana ikkar, ka mashma lan: kimcha ikkar.

Amar rav berona amar rav: goy shehitztzit et haur baagam — kol hachagavim shebbaagam asurin. hechi dame? illema dela yada he tahor vehe tame, may irya goy? afillu yisrael name! ella mishshum bishshule goyim.

Ki hay gavvna mi asir? vehaamar rav chanan bar amme amar rabbi pedat amar rabbi yochanan: hay goy decharech resha shere lemechal minneh, afillu meresh unneh. alma leabbore sear kamikkavven, hacha name legalloye agma ka mikkavven!
Leolam, dela yada he tahor vehe tame, umaase shehaya begoy haya.

Gufa, amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: hay goy decharech resha — shere lemechal minneh, afillu meresh unne. amar ravina: hilkach, hay goy dishda sikketa leattuna, ukevar bah yisrael kara meikkara — shappir dame. peshita! mahu detema: levashshole mana ka mikkavven, ka mashma lan: lesharore mana ka mikkavven.

Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: hinniach yisrael basar al gabbe gechalim, uva goy vehippech bo — muttar. hechi dame? illema dei la happech beh hava beshil — peshita! ella lav dei la happech la hava beshil, ammay muttar? bishshule shel goyim ninhu!
La tzericha, dei la happech hava beshil betarte shae, vehasheta ka veshil bachada shata, mahu detema: karove bishshula milleta hi, ka mashma lan.
Vehaamar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan: kol shehu kemaachal ben derosay — en bo mishshum bishshule goyim, ha eno kemaachal ben derosay — yesh bo mishshum bishshule goyim!
Hatam, kegon deotveh besilta, veshakleh goy veotveh betannura.

Tanya name hachi: manniach yisrael basar al gabbe gechalim, uva goy umehappech bo ad sheyyavo yisrael mibbet hakkeneset o mibbet hammidrash, veeno choshesh. shofetet ishsha kedera al gabbe kira, uvat goya
b: Umegisa, ad shettavo mibbet hammerchatz o mibbet hakkeneset, veenah chosheshet.
Ibbaya lehu: hinniach goy vehippech yisrael, mahu? amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: kal vachomer — gemaro beyad goy muttar, gemaro beyad yisrael lo kol shekken?

Ittemar name: amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan, veamri la amar rav acha bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: ben shehinniach goy vehafach yisrael, ben shehinniach yisrael vehafach goy — muttar, veeno asur ad shettehe techillato ugemaro beyad goy.
Amar ravina, hilcheta: ha rifta dishgar goy vaafa yisrael, i name shegar yisrael vaafa goy, i name shegar goy vaafa goy vaata yisrael vechatti ba chattoye — shappir dame.

Dag maliach — chizkiyya share, verabbi yochanan asar. betza tzeluya — bar kappara share, verabbi yochanan asar. ki ata rav dimi amar: echad dag maliach veechad betza tzeluya — chizkiyya uvar kappara sharu, verabbi yochanan asar.

Rabbi chiyyay parvava ikkela leve resh galuta, amaru leh: betza tzeluya may? amar lehu: chizkiyya uvar kappara sharu, verabbi yochanan asar, veen devarav shel echad bimkom shenayim. amar lehu rav zevid: la tetzitu leh, hachi amar abbaye: hilcheta kevavteh derabbi yochanan. ashkeyu nagota dechalla venach nafsheh.
Tanu rabbanan: hakkafresin, vehakkaflotot, vehammitalya, vehachammin, vehakkelayot shellahen — muttarin, betza tzeluya — asura, shemen — rabbi yehuda hannasi uvet dino nimnu alav vehittiruhu.

Tanya: hi hammitalya hi pasilya hi shiata. may shiata? amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: ha arbein shenin denafek hay ovada mimmitzrayim, verabba bar bar chana dideh amar: ha shittin shenin denafek hay ovada mimmitzrayim, vela peligi — mar bishneh umar bishneh.

Mayytu bizra decharpesa uvizra dechittana uvizra deshavlilta, vetaru lehu bahade hadade befashore, veshavku leh ad dimkabbel, umayyte chatzve chadte umalu lehu mayya, vetaru behu gargishta umedabbekin beh, veayylin leve vane (addenafku) [addenafki] melavlevi, veachli minnayyhu, vekayyri mibbinta dereshayyhu ad tufera decharayyhu. amar rav ashe: amar li rabbi chanina: millin, veamri la: bemilin.

Tanu rabbanan: hakkusepan shel goyim shehuchammu (chammin) [chammav] beyora gedola — asur, beyora ketanna — muttar. veezo hi yora ketanna? amar rabbi yannay: kol sheen tzippor deror yachol likkanes betochah.
Vedilma admoye admu veayyeylu! ella, kol sheen rosh tzippor deror yachol likkanes betochah.
Vehatanya: achat yora gedola veachat yora ketanna muttar! la kashya, ha keman deamar: noten taam lifgam asur, ha keman deamar: noten taam lifgam muttar.

Amar rav sheshet: hay mishcha shelika daarammae asur. amar rav safra: lemay nechush la? i mishshum iarove — misra sere, i mishshum bishshule goyim — neechol hu kemo shehu chay, i mishshum giule goyim — noten taam lifgam hu umuttar.

Beo minneh merabbi assi: hane ahine shelike daarammae may? chuleye — la tibbee lach, devadday sheru. merire — la tibbee lach, devadday asiri. ki tibbee lach metziae, may? amar lehu: may tibbee lehu? derabbi asar. umannu? levi.

Shattita — rav share, avu dishmuel velevi asri. bechitte useare kulle alma la peligi dishre, bitlafche dechalla kulle alma la peligi daasir. ki peligi — bitlafche demayya: mar savar gazrinan ha attu ha, umar savar la gazrinan.
Veikka deamri: bitlafche demayya kulle alma la peligi daasir, ki peligi — bechitte useare, mar savar: gazrinan ha attu ha, umar savar: la gazrinan.

Amar rav: tere mine shattita shaddar barzillay haggiladi ledavid, dichtiv: "mishkav vesappot ucheli yotzer chittim useorim vekemach vekali ufol vaadashim vekali", vehasheta hu deka mappeki tzanne tzanne leshuke dinhardea, velet dechayesh leha daavu dishmuel velevi.

Uchevashin sheddarkan latet betochan yayin. amar chizkiyya: lo shanu ella sheddarkan, aval beyadua — asur afillu bahanaa. umay shena mimmureyays desharu rabbanan bahanaa? hatam — leabbore zuhama, hacha — lemattoke tama.
Verabbi yochanan amar: afillu beyadua name muttar, umay shena mimmureyays lerabbi meir daasir bahanaa?

a: Hatam yedia mammasho, hacha la yedia mammashan.
Vetarit terufa, vetzir sheen bah daga vechulei. may chillek? amar rav nachman bar abba amar rav: zo suletanit, umippene ma asura? mippene sheervonah ole immah.

Tanu rabbanan: en lo achshav veatid legaddel leachar zeman, kegon hassuletanit (vehaafyatz) [vehaafyayn] — hare ze muttar. yesh lo achshav veatid lehashshir beshaa sheole min hayyam, kegon akunas vaafunas, ketaspatyays veachsepatyays vaatunas — muttar.
Achrez rabbi avahu bekesari: kirve dagim veubbaran nikkachin mikkol adam. chezkatan enan baim ella mippillusa veaspamya, ki ha deamar abbaye: hay tzachanta devav nahara sharya.
May tama? illema mishshum dirdifi mayya, vehay dag tame kevan delet leh chut hashshidra, beducheta dirdifi mayya la matze kae, veha ka chazenan dekae!

Ella mishshum dimlichi mayya, vehay dag tame — kevan delet leh kilfe, beducheta dimlichi mayya la matze kae. veha kachazenan dekae! ella, mishshum dela merabbe tina dag tame. amar ravina: haiddana deka shafchi beh nehar goza unehar gamda — asiri.
Amar abbaye: hay chamra deyamma — shere, tora deyamma — asir, vesimanaych: tame tahor, tahor tame.
Amar rav ashe: shefar nuna shere, kedash nuna asir, vesimanaych: "kodesh laAdonai". ikka deamri: kevar nuna asur, vesimanaych: kivre goyim.

Rabbi akiva ikkela leginzak, ayyto lekammeh hahu nuna dahava dame lechippusha, chappeyeh bedikkula, chaza beh kilfe vesharyeh. rav ashe ikkela letamdorya, ayyto lekammeh hahu nuna dahava dame litzlofcha, nakteh lahade yoma, chaza dahava beh tzimche vesharyeh.

Rav ashe ikkela lehahu atra, ayyto lekammeh nuna dehave dame lishfarnuna, chappeyeh bimshichle chivvare, chaza beh kilfe vesharyeh. rabba bar bar chana ikkela leakra deagma, karivu leh tzachanta, shameh lehahu gavra dahava kare leh "bate".
Amar: middeka kare leh "bate", shema minna davar tame it beh, la achal minneh. letzafra ayyen be, ashkach beh davar tame, kare annafsheh: "lo yeunne latztzaddik kol aven".

Vehakkoret shel chiltit. may tama? mishshum demafseki leh besakkina. af al gav deamar mar: noten taam lifgam muttar, aggav churepeh dechiltita mechalleya leh shamnunita, vehave leh kenoten taam leshevach, veasur.
Avdeh derabbi levi hava ka mezabben chiltita, ki nach nafsheh derabbi levi ato lekammeh derabbi yochanan, amaru leh: mahu lemizban minneh? amar lehu: avdo shel chaver hare hu kechaver.
Rav huna bar minyome zeven techelta meenashe deveteh derav amram chasida, ata lekammeh derav yosef, la hava bideh.

Pega beh chanan chayyayta, amar leh: yosef anya mena leh? bedidi hava ovada, dizveni techelta meenashe deveteh deravnaa achu derabbi chiyyay bar abba, vaatay lekammeh derav matna, la hava bideh. atay lekammeh derav yehuda mehageronya, amar li: nefalt leyad, hachi amar shemuel: eshet chaver hare hi kechaver.

Tenena leha detanu rabbanan: eshet chaver hare hi kechaver, avdo shel chaver hare hu kechaver, chaver shemmet — ishto uvanav uvene veto hare hen bechezkatan ad sheyyechashdu, vechen chatzer shemmochrin bah techelet hare (hen bechezkatan) [hi bechezkatah] ad shettippasel.

Tanu rabbanan: eshet am haaretz shennisset lechaver, vechen bitto shel am haaretz shennisset lechaver, vechen avdo shel am haaretz shennimkar lechaver — kullan tzerichin lekabbel divre chaverut, aval eshet chaver shennisset leam haaretz, vechen bitto shel chaver shennisset leam haaretz, vechen avdo shel chaver shennimkar leam haaretz — enan tzerichin lekabbel divre chaverut lechattechilla, divre rabbi meir.

Rabbi yehuda omer: af hen tzerichin lekabbel divre chaverut lechattechilla. vechen haya rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: maase beishsha achat shennisset lechaver, vehayta kosheret lo tefillin al yado, nisset lemoches, vehayta kosheret lo kishre moches al yado.
Amar rav: 420 asur bechotam echad, 131 muttar bechotam echad. chalav, basar, yayin, techelet.
b: Asurin bechotam echad. chiltit, mureyays, pat, gevina — muttarin bechotam echad.
Pat, lemay nechush la? i mishshum ichallofe karira bechammima — midda yedia, dechitte bedisare name midda yedia, i ki hadade — kevan deikka chotam echad la tarach umezayyef.
Verav, may shena gevina? dela tarach umezayyef? chalav name la tarach umezayyef! amar rav kahana: appek chalav, veayyel chatichat dag sheen bah siman.
Hayeynu basar! tere gavvne basar.

Ushemuel omer: 412 asur bechotam echad, 51 muttar bechotam echad. basar, yayin, techelet asurin bechotam echad; mureyays, chiltit, gevina muttarin bechotam echad. lishmuel, chatichat dag sheen bah siman hayeynu basar, tere gavvne basar la amrinan.
Tanu rabbanan: en lokchin 58 51 besureya, lo yayin velo mureyays velo chalav velo melach salkonderit velo chiltit velo gevina, ella min hammumeche, vechullan im nitarach etzel baal habbayit — muttar.

Mesayyay leh lerabbi yehoshua ben levi, deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: shigger lo baal habbayit leveto — muttar. may tama? baal habbayit la shavek hettera veachel issura, vechi meshaggar leh, mimmay deachel meshaddar leh.

Umelach salkonderit. may melach salkonderit? amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: melach shekkol salkondere romi ochlin otah. tanu rabbanan: melach salkonderit, shechora — asura, levana — mutteret, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: levana — asura, shechora — mutteret. rabbi yehuda ben gamliel mishshum rabbi chanina ben gamliel omer: zo vezo asura.
Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: ledivre haomer levana asura, kirve dagim levanim temeim meoravin bah. ledivre haomer shechora asura, kirve dagim shechorim temeim meoravin bah.
Ledivre haomer zo vezo asura, ze vaze meoravin bah. amar rabbi avahu mishshum rabbi chanina ben gamliel: zaken echad haya bishchunatenu, shehaya machlik paneha beshumman chazir.
Hare ellu asurim. lemaote may? lechizkiyya — lemaote beyadua, lerabbi yochanan — lemaote mureyays ugevinat bet uneyayke, usetama kerabbi meir.

Mishna veellu muttarin baachila — chalav shechalavo goy veyisrael roehu, vehaddevash, vehadduvdevaniyyot, af al pi shemmenattefin — en bahen mishshum hechsher mashke, uchevashin sheen darkan latet letochan yayin vachometz, vetarit sheenah terufa, vetzir sheyyesh bah daga, veale shel chiltit, vezete gelusekaot hamegulegalin.
Rabbi yose omer: hashshelachin asurin, hachagavim habbaim min hasselula asurin, min haheftek muttarin, vechen litruma.

Gemara tenena leha detanu rabbanan: yoshev yisrael betzad edro shel goy, vegoy cholev umevi lo, veeno choshesh. hechi dame? i delekka davar tame beedro — peshita, vei deikka davar tame beedro — ammay?

Leolam deikka davar tame, vechi kae chaze leh, vechi yatev la chaze leh; mahu detema: kevan deyatev la chaze leh, nechush dilma mayyte umearev beh, ka mashma lan: kevan dechi kae chaze leh, irtote mirtat vela meyarev beh.
Vehaddevash. devash lemay nechush la? i mishshum iarove — misra sere, i mishshum bishshule goyim — neechol kemo shehu chay, i mishshum giule goyim — noten taam lifgam hu umuttar.
Vehadduvdevaniyyot. af al pi shemmenattefot, en bahen mishshum hechsher mashke. ureminhi: habbotzer laggat — shammay omer: hucheshar, hillel omer: lo hucheshar, veodi leh hillel leshammay!
Hatam ka vae leh lemashke, hacha la ka vae leh lemashke.
Vetarit sheenah terufa: tanu rabbanan, ezo hi tarit sheenah terufa? kol sherosh veshidra nikkar. veezo tzir sheyyesh bah daga? kol shekkilbit achat o shete kilbiyyot

a: Shottot bo. hasheta kilbit achat amrat shere, shete kilbiyyot mibbaya? la kashya: kan biftuchot, kan bistumot.

Ittemar: rav huna amar: ad (shettehe) [sheyyehe] rosh veshidra nikkar, rav nachman amar: o rosh o shidra. metiv rav ukeva bar chama: uvaddagim kol sheyyesh lo senappir vekaskeset! amar abbaye: ki tanya hahi beara ufalmuda, dedamu reshayyhu litmeim.

Amar rav yehuda mishshemeh deulla: machloket letabbel betziran, aval begufan — divre hakkol asur ad sheyyehe rosh veshidra nikkar. amar rabbi zera: meresh hava metabbelna betziran, kevan dishmana leha deamar rav yehuda mishshemeh deulla: machloket letabbel betziran, aval begufan — divre hakkol asur ad sheyyehe rosh veshidra nikkar, betziran name la metabbelna.

Amar rav pappa, hilcheta: ad sheyyehe rosh veshidra nikkar shel kol achat veachat. metivi: chatichot sheyyesh bahen siman, ben bechullan ben bemiktzatan, vaafillu beechad mimmea shebbahen — kullan muttarot, umaase begoy echad shehevi garav shel chatichot, venimtza siman beachat mehen, vehittir rabban shimon ben gamliel et haggarav kullo!
Targema rav pappa: keshechatichot shavot. i hachi, may lememra? mahu detema nechush dilma itremi, ka mashma lan.

Hahu arba detzachanta daatay lesichra, nefak rav huna bar chinnana vachaza beh kilfe vesharyeh. amar leh rava: umi ikka deshare kehay gavvna beatra dishchichi kilfe? nafek shippure derava veasar, shippure derav huna bar chinnana veshare.

Amar rav yirmeya middifti: ledidi amar li rav pappe, ki shera rav huna bar chinnana — betziran, aval begufan la. amar rav ashe: ledidi amar li rav pappa, ki shera rav huna bar chinnana — afillu begufan.

Vaana la mesar asarna, dekaamar li rav pappa, vela mishre sharena, deha amar (li) rav yehuda mishshemeh deulla: machloket letabbel betziran, aval begufan — divre hakkol ad sheyyehe rosh veshidra nikkar shel kol echad veechad.

Yatev rav chinnana bar idi kammeh derav adda bar ahava, veyatev vekaamar: goy shehevi areva melea chaviyyot, venimtzet kilbit beachat mehen — petuchot, kullan muttarot; setumot, hi mutteret vechullan asurot. amar leh: mena lach ha? mittelata kerae shemia li, merav ushemuel verabbi yochanan.

Amar rav berona amar rav: kirve dagim veubbaran en nikkachin ella min hammumeche. rame leh ulla lerabbi dostay demin bere, middekaamar rav: kirve dagim veubbaran en nikkachin ella min hammumeche — mikkelal dedag tame it leh ubbar, ureminhi: dag tame mashritz, dag tahor metil betzim!
Semi mikkan "ubbaran". amar leh rabbi zera: la tisme, tarvayyhu metile betzim ninhu, ella ze mashritz mibbachutz, veze mashritz mibbifnim.

Lema li mumeche? livdok besimanin! detanya: kesimane vetzim kach simane dagim. simane dagim salka datach? simane dagim "senappir vekashkeshet" ketiv behu! ella, kesimane vetzim kach simane ubbere dagim.

Veellu hen simane vetzim: kol shekkoderet vaagulegolet, roshah echad kad veroshah echad chad — tehora, shene rasheha chaddin ushene rasheha kaddin — temea, chelmon mibbachutz vechelbon mibbifnim — temea, chelbon mibbachutz vechelmon mibbifnim — tahor, chelbon vechelmon meoravin ze baze — zo hi betzat hashsheretz. amar rava: keshennimmochu.
Ulerabbi dostay demin bere, deamar: semi mikkan "ubbaran",
b: Vehatanya: kesimane vetzim kach simane ubbere dagim! lav tarotze metartzat la? kach simane kirve dagim.
Vehechi mashkachat besimane kirve dagim sheyyehe kad vechad? mashkachat la beshilpucha.

Im en sham mumeche, may? amar rav yehuda: kevan deamar "ani melachtim" — muttarin. rav nachman amar: ad sheyyomar "ellu dagim veellu kirvehen". ori leh rav yehuda laada dayyayla: kevan deamar "ani melachtim" — muttarin.
Veale shel chiltit. peshita! lo nitzrecha ella likratin shebbo. mahu detema: nechush dilma mayyte umearev beh, ka mashma lan deha ishteroke hi deishteruk vaata bahada.
Vezete gelusekaot hamegulegalin. peshita! lo nitzrecha af al gav derafe tuva. mahu detema: chamra rema behu, ka mashma lan: hane mechamat mishcha hu dirfu.
Verabbi yose omer: shelachin asurin. hechi dame shelachin? amar rabbi yose bar chanina: kol sheochazo beyado vegarinato nishmetet.

Hachagavin habbain kulei. tanu rabbanan: hachagavin, vehakkafresin, vehakkaflotot habbain min haotzar umin haheftek umin hassefina — muttarin, hannimkarin bekatluza lifne chenvani — asurin, mippene shemmezallef yayin alehen. vechen yen tappuchim shel goyim habbain min haotzar umin haheftek umin hasselula — muttarin, hannimkar bekatluza — asur, mippene shemmearvin bo yayin.

Tanu rabbanan: paam achat chash rabbi bemeav, amar: kelum yesh adam sheyyodea yen tappuchim shel goyim asur o muttar? amar lefanav rabbi yishmael ben rabbi yose: paam achat chash abba bemeav, veheviu lo yen tappuchim shel goyim shel shivim shana, veshata venitrappe. amar lo: kol kach haya beyadcha veatta metzaareni!
Badku umatzu goy echad shehaya lo shelosh meot garve yayin shel tappuchim shel shivim shana, veshata venitrappe, amar: baruch hammakom shemmasar olamo leshomrim!

Vechen litruma. may "vechen litruma"? amar rav sheshet: vechen lechohen hechashud limkor teruma leshem chullin, lefanav hu deasur, aval habba min haotzar umin haheftek umin hasselula muttar, irtote mirtat, savar: shami bi rabbanan (umafsedu) [umafsedi] leh minnay.
Hadaran alach en maamidin.

Mishna kol hatztzelamim asurin, mippene shehen neevadin paam achat beshana, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: eno asur ella kol sheyyesh beyado makkel o tzippor o chaddur. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: af kol sheyyesh beyado kol davar.

Gemara i deneevadin paam achat bashshana, may tama derabbanan? amar rabbi yitzchak bar yosef amar rabbi yochanan: bimkomo shel rabbi meir hayu ovdin otah paam achat bashshana, verabbi meir dechayesh lemiuta — gazar shear mekomot attu oto makom, verabbanan dela chayyshi lemiuta — la gazru shear mekomot attu oto makom.
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: beinderati shel melachim shaninu. amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: uveomdin al petach medina shaninu.

a: Amar rabba: machloket beshel kefarim, aval beshel kerakkim — divre hakkol muttarin, may tama? lenoy avdi lehu.
Vedichfarim, mi ikka leman deamar lenoy kaavdi lehu? dichfarim vadday lemiflechinhu avdi lehu!
Ella i ittemar, hachi ittemar: amar rabba: machloket beshel kerakkim, aval beshel kefarim — divre hakkol asurim.

Vachachamim omrim: enan asurin vechulei. makkel — sherode et atzmo tachat kol haolam kullo kemakkel, tzippor — shettofes et atzmo tachat kol haolam kullo ketzippor, kaddur — shettofes et atzmo tachat kol haolam kullo kechaddur.
Tana, hosifu alehen: sayif, atara, vetabbaat.
Sayif — meikkara sevur listim bealma, ulevassof sevur shehoreg et atzmo tachat kol haolam kullo.
Atara — meikkara sevur gadel kelile bealma, ulevassof sevur kaatara lakkelev. tabbaat — meikkara sevur ishteyayma bealma, ulevassof sevur shechotem et atzmo tachat kol haolam kullo lemita.
Rabban shimon ben gamliel kulei. tana: afillu tzeror, afillu kesam.
Bae rav ashe: tafas beyado tzoa, mahu? mi amrinan kulle alma zilu beappeh ki tzoa, o dilma hu mihu dezil beappe kulle alma ketzoa? teku.
Mishna hammotze shivre tzelamim, hare ellu muttarin. matza tavnit yad o tavnit regel, hare ellu asurin, mippene shekkayyotze bahen neevad.
Gemara amar shemuel: afillu shivre avoda zara. vehaanan tenan: shivre tzelamim!
Hu haddin daafillu shivre avoda zara, veha dekatane shivre tzelamim — mishshum dekavae lemitne sefa: matza tavnit yad tavnit regel — hare ellu asurin, mippene shekkayyotze bahen neevad.
Tenan: matza tavnit yad tavnit regel — hare ellu asurin, mippene shekkayyotze bo neevad. ammay?
b: Veha shevarim ninhu! targema shemuel: beomdin al besisan.
Ittemar: avoda zara shennishtabbera meeleha, rabbi yochanan amar: asura, rabbi shimon ben lakish amar: mutteret.
Rabbi yochanan amar: asura, deha la batla. rabbi shimon ben lakish amar: mutteret, missetama battole mevattel la, memar amar: ihi nafsha la atztzela, lehahu gavra matztzela leh?
Etiveh rabbi yochanan lerabbi shimon ben lakish: "verosh dagon ushete kappot yadav kerutot vegomer", uchetiv: "al ken lo yidrechu chohane dagon vegomer"!
Amar lo: mishsham reaya? hatam shemmannichin et haddagon, veovdin et hammiftan, deamri hachi: shavkeh isareh ledagon, vaata ittev leh al hammiftan.
Etiveh: hammotze shivre tzelamim — hare ellu muttarin. ha shivre avoda zara — asurin!
La tema shivre avoda zara asurin, ella ema: ha tzelamim atzman asurin, usetama kerabbi meir.
Verabbi yochanan, midderabbi meir nishma lehu lerabbanan, lav amar rabbi meir: tzelamim asurin, shivre tzelamim muttarin, lerabbanan avoda zara name hi asura ushevareha muttarin!
Hachi hasheta? hatam emar avadum emar lo avadum, veim timtze lomar avadum — emar bittelum. avoda zara vadday avaduha, mi yemar devatteluha? have safek uvadday, veen safek motzi mide vadday!
Veen safek motzi mide vadday? vehatanya: chaver shemmet, vehinniach megura melea perot, afillu hen bene yoman — hare hen bechezkat metukkanin.
Veha hacha devadday tevili, safek asserinhu, safek la asserinhu, vekaate safek umotzi mide vadday!
Hatam vadday uvadday hu, devadday asserinhu, kidrabbi chanina chozaa, deamar rabbi chanina chozaa: chazaka al chaver sheeno motzi davar sheeno metukkan mittachat yado.
Vei baet ema: meikkara la tevili, safek vesafek hu.
Efshar daavad kidrabbi oshaya, deamar: maarim adam al tevuato umachnisah bammotz shellah, kede shettehe behemto ochelet ufetura min hammaaser.
Veen safek motzi mide vadday? vehatanya, amar rabbi yehuda: maase beshifchato

a: Shel metzik echad berimmon, shehetila nefel levor, uva kohen vehetzitz leda im zachar im nekeva, uva maase lifne chachamim vetiharuhu, mippene shechuleda uvardelas metzuyin sham.
Veha hacha, devadday hetila nefel, safek gerruhu, safek lo gerruhu, vekaate safek umotzi mide vadday!
La tema hetila nefel levor, ella ema: hetila kemin nefel levor.
Veha "leda im zachar im nekeva hu" katane!
Hachi kaamar: leda im ruach hippila, im nefel hetila, veim timtze lomar nefel hetila — leda im zachar im nekeva.
Veibbaet ema: kevan shechuleda uvardelas metzuyin sham — vadday gerruhu.
Etiveh: matza tavnit yad, tavnit regel — hare ellu asurin, mippene shekkayyotze bahen neevad. ammay? ha shevarim ninhu!
Ha targema shemuel: beomdin al besisan.
Etiveh: goy mevattel avoda zara shello veshel chavero, veyisrael eno mevattel avoda zara shel goy. ammay? tehve kaavoda zara shennishtabbera meeleha!
Amar abbaye: sheppechasah. vechi pechasah may have? veha tenan: pechasah af al pi shello chisserah — bittelah!
Hane mille defachasa goy, aval pachasa yisrael la battela.
Verava amar: leolam ki fachasa yisrael name battela, ella gezera dilma magba la vahadar mevattel la, vehave avoda zara beyad yisrael, vechol avoda zara beyad yisrael enah betela leolam.

Etiveh: goy shehevi avanim min hammarkulis, vechippa bahen derachim uteratyaot — muttarot, veyisrael shehevi avanim min hammarkulis vechippa bahen derachim uteratyaot — asurot. ammay? tehve kaavoda zara shennishtabbera meeleha!
Hacha name, kidrava.

Etiveh: goy sheshshippa avoda zara letzorko — hi veshippuyeha muttarin, letzorkah — hi asura veshippuyeha muttarin, veyisrael sheshshippa avoda zara, ben letzorko ben letzorkah — hi veshippuyeha asurin. ammay? tehve kaavoda zara shennishtabbera meeleha!
Hacha name, kidrava.
Etiveh: rabbi yose omer: shochek vezore laruach o metil layyam. amru lo: af hi naaset zevel, uchetiv: "lo yidbak beyadcha meuma min hacherem". ammay? tehve kaavoda zara shennishtabbera meeleha!
Hacha name, kidrava.

Etiveh: rabbi yose ben yasyan omer: matza tzurat derakon verosho chatuch, safek goy chatacho safek yisrael chatacho — muttar, vadday yisrael chatacho — asur. ammay? tehve kaavoda zara shennishtabbera meeleha!
Hacha name, kidrava.
Etiveh: rabbi yose omer, af lo yerakot bimot haggeshamim, mippene shehanneviyyay nosheret alehen. ammay? tehve kaavoda zara shennishtabbera meeleha!
Shane hatam, deikkar avoda zara kayyemet.
b: Veha shippuyayn, deikkar avoda zara kayyemet, vekatane: letzorkah — hi asura, veshippuyeha muttarin!
Rav huna bereh derav yehoshua amar: lefi sheen avoda zara betela derech gedilatah.
Etiveh rabbi shimon ben lakish lerabbi yochanan: ken shebberosh hailan shel hekdesh — lo nehenin velo moalin, beroshah shel ashera — yattiz bekane.
Ka salka datach, kegon sheshshibbera mimmennu etzim vekinnetah bahen, vekatane: yattiz bekane.
Hacha bemay askinan? kegon deayytay etzim mealma, vekinnetah bahen.

Dayka name, dekatane gabbe hekdesh: lo nehenin velo moalin; i amrat bishlama deayytay etzim mealma, hayeynu dekatane gabbe hekdesh: lo nehenin velo moalin — lo nehenin midderabbanan, velo moalin middeorayyta, deha la kaddishi.
Ella i amrat sheshshibbera etzim mimmennu, vekinnetah bahen, ammay lo moalin? ha kaddishi!
Midde irya? hacha begiddulin habbain leachar mikkan askinan, veka savar en meila begiddulin.
Verabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan: may "yattiz"? yattiz baefrochin.
Amar leh rabbi yaakov lerabbi yirmeya bar tachlifa: asbera lach, beefrochin — kan vechan muttarin, bevetzim — kan vechan asurin. amar rav ashe: veefrochin shetztzerichin leimman kevetzim damu.
Mishna hammotze kelim vaalehem tzurat chamma, tzurat levana, tzurat derakon — yolichem leyam hammelach. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: sheal hamechubbadin — asurin, sheal hamevuzzin — muttarin.

Gemara lememra dilhane hu defalchi lehu, lemidde acharina la? ureminhi: hashshochet leshum yammim, leshum neharot, leshum midbar, leshum chamma, leshum levana, leshum kochavim umazzalot, leshum michael sar haggadol, leshum shilshul katan — hare ellu zivche metim!
Amar abbaye: miflach lechol demashkechi palchi, metzar umiflachoy — hane telata dachashivi tzayyri lehu ufalchi lehu, lemidde acharina — lenoy bealma avdi lehu.

Menakket rav sheshet chumere matneyayta vetane: kol hammazzalot muttarin — chutz mimmazzal chamma ulevana, vechol happartzufin muttarin — chutz mippartzuf adam, vechol hatztzurot muttarot — chutz mitztzurat derakon.

Amar mar: kol hammazzalot muttarin, chutz mimmazzal chamma ulevana. hacha bemay askinan? ilema beose — i beose, kol hammazzalot mi shere? vehachtiv: "lo taasun itti" — lo taasun kidmut shammashay hameshammeshin lefanay bammarom.
Ella peshita bemotze, ucheditnan: hammotze kelim vaalehem tzurat chamma, tzurat levana, tzurat derakon — yolichem leyam hammelach.

I bemotze, ema metziata: kol happartzufot muttarin chutz mippartzuf adam; i bemotze, partzuf adam mi asur? vehatnan: hammotze kelim vaalehem tzurat chamma, tzurat levana, tzurat derakon — yolichem leyam hammelach. tzurat derakon — in, partzuf adam — la!
Ella peshita beose, vechidrav huna bereh derav yehoshua.
I beose, ema sefa: kol hatztzurot muttarot — chutz mitztzurat derakon; vei beose, tzurat derakon mi asir? vehachtiv: "lo taasun itti elohe chesef velohe zahav",

a: Hane — in, tzurat derakon — la!
Ella peshita bemotze, ucheditnan: hammotze kelim vaalehem tzurat chamma.
Resha vesefa bemotze, umetziata beose?
Amar abbaye: in, resha vesefa bemotze, umetziata beose.

Rava amar: kullah bemotze, umetziata rabbi yehuda hi. detanya: rabbi yehuda mosif af demut menika vesar afes. menika — al shem chavva shemmenika kol haolam kullo, sar afes — al shem yosef shessar umefis et kol haolam kullo. vehu denaket geriva veka chayel, vehi denakta ben veka menika.

Tanu rabbanan: ezehu tzurat derakon? peresh rabbi shimon ben elazar: kol sheyyesh lo tzitzin ben perakav. machve rabbi assi: ben pirke tzavvar. amar rabbi chama berabbi chanina: halacha kerabbi shimon ben elazar.

Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: paam achat hayiti mehallech achar rabbi elazar hakkappar beribbi badderech, umatza sham tabbaat vealeha tzurat derakon, umatza goy katan vela amar lo kelum, matza goy gadol veamar lo: battelah, velo bittelah, setaro uvittelah.

Shema minna telat: shema minna goy mevattel avoda zara shello veshel chavero, ushema minna yodea betiv shel avoda zara umeshammesheha mevattel, vesheeno yodea betiv avoda zara umeshammesheha eno mevattel, ushema minna goy mevattel beal korcho.

Megaddef ba rabbi chanina, velet leh lerabbi elazar hakkappar beribbi ha ditnan: hammatztzil min haari umin haddov umin hannamer umin haggayis umin hannahar umizzoto shel yam umishshelulito shel nahar, vehammotze bisratya ufelatya gedola, uvechol makom sheharabbim metzuyin sham — hare ellu shello, mippene shehabbealim mityayashin mehen?
Amar abbaye: nehi deminna miyyayash, meissura mi miyyayash? memar amar: i goy mashkach la — miflach palach la, i yisrael mashkach la — ayyeyde dedameha yekarin mezabben la legoy ufalach la.
Tenan hatam: demut tzurot levanot haya lo lerabban gamliel baaliyyayto, betavla bakkotel, shebbahen mare et hahedyotot, veomer lahen: kaze reitem o kaze reitem?
Umi shere? vehachtiv: "lo taasun itti", lo taasun kidmut shammashay hameshammeshim lefanay!
Amar abbaye: lo asra tora ella shammashin sheefshar laasot kemotan,

Kidtanya: lo yaase adam bayit tavnit hechol, achsadra tavnit ulam, chatzer tavnit azara, shulechan tavnit shulechan, menora tavnit menora, aval hu ose shel chamesh veshel shesh veshel shemone, veshel sheva lo yaase afillu shel shear mine mattachot.
Rabbi yose bar yehuda omer: af shel etz lo yaase, kederech sheasu bet chashmonay.
Amru lo: mishsham reaya? shappudin shel barzel hayu, (vechofin) [vechippum] bevaatz, heeshiru — asaum shel kesef, chazru veheeshiru — asaum shel zahav.
Veshammashin shei efshar laasot kemotan mi shere? vehatanya: "lo taasun itti" — lo taasun kidmut shammashay hameshammeshim lefanay bammarom!
Amar abbaye:
b: Lo asra tora ella bidmut arbaa panim bahade hadade.
Ella meatta, partzuf adam lechodeh tishtere! allema tanya: kol happartzufot muttarin, chutz mippartzuf adam?
Amar rav yehuda bereh derav yehoshua: mippirkeh derabbi yehoshua shemia li, "lo taasun itti" — lo taasun oti, aval shear shammashin shere.
Ushear shammashin mi shere? vehatanya: "lo taasun itti" — lo taasun kidmut shammashay hameshammeshin lefanay bemarom, kegon ofannim userafim vechayyot hakkodesh umalache hashsharet!
Amar abbaye: lo asra tora ella shammashin shebbammador haelyon.
Veshebbemador hattachton mi shere? vehatanya: "asher bashshamayim" — lerabbot chamma ulevana kochavim umazzalot, "mimmaal" — lerabbot malache hashsharet!
Ki tanya hahi, leovdam.
I leovdam, afillu shilshul katan name! in hachi name, umissefeh dikra nafka, detanya: "asher baaretz" — lerabbot yammim uneharot harim ugevaot, "mittachat" — lerabbot shilshul katan.
Vaasiyyay geredta mi shere? vehatanya: "lo taasun itti" — lo taasun kidmut shammashay hameshammeshin lefanay bammarom, kegon: chamma ulevana, kochavim umazzalot.
Shane rabban gamliel, daacherim asu lo.
Veha rav yehuda, daacherim asu lo, vaamar leh shemuel lerav yehuda: shinnana, sammi eneh deden!
Hatam bechotamo bolet, umishshum chashada, detanya: tabbaat shechotamah bolet — asur lehannichah, umuttar lachtom bah. chotamah shokea — muttar lehannichah, veasur lachtom bah.
Umi chayyshinan lachashada? veha be chenishta deshaf vitev binhardea, (deokmi) [deokimu] beh inderata, vahavo ayyli beh avu dishmuel velevi umetzallu begavveh, vela chayyshi lachashada! rabbim shane.
Veha rabban gamliel deyachid hava? kevan denasi hu, shechichi rabbim gabbeh. veibbaet ema: difrakim havay.
Veibbaet ema, lehitlammed shane, detanya: "lo tilmad laasot", aval atta lamed lehavin ulehorot.
Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer vechulei. ezo hen mechubbadin, veezo hen mevuzzin?
Amar rav: mechubbadin — lemala min hammayim, mevuzzin — lematta min hammayim. ushemuel amar: ellu vaellu mevuzzin hen, ella ellu hen mechubbadin — sheal hashsherin veal hannezamim veal hattabbaot.
Tanya kevavteh dishmuel: mechubbadin — sheal hashsherin, veal hannezamim, veal hattabbaot; mevuzzin — sheal hayyorot, veal hakkumekmosin, veal mechamme chammim, vesheal hassedinin, veal hammitpachot.
Mishna rabbi yose omer: shochek vezore laruach, o metil layyam. amru lo: af hu naase zevel, shenneemar: "lo yidbak beyadcha meuma min hacherem".
Gemara tanya, amar lahem rabbi yose, vahalo kevar neemar: "veet chattatchem

a: Asher asitem et haegel lakachti vaesrof oto baesh vaekkot oto tachon hetev ad asher dak leafar vaashlich et afaro el hannachal hayyored min hahar"!
Amru lo: mishsham reaya? hare hu omer: "vayyizer al pene hammayim vayyashk et bene yisrael", lo nitkavven ella levodkan kesotot.

Amar lahem rabbi yose: vahalo kevar neemar "vegam et maacha immo hesirah miggevira asher asta miflatztah vegomer vayyadek vayyisrof benachal kidron"! amar lo: mishsham reaya? nachal kidron eno megaddel tzemachin!

Vela? vehatanya: ellu veellu mitarvin beamma, veyotzin lenachal kidron, venimkarin legannanin lezevel, umoalin bahen! mekomot mekomot yesh bo: yesh makom megaddel tzemachin, veyesh makom sheen megaddel tzemachin.
May "miflatztah"? amar rav yehuda: dahava mafleya letzanuta, kidtane rav yosef: kemin zachrut asta lah, vehayta nivelet lo bechol yom.
Amar lahen rabbi yose, vahalo kevar neemar: "vechittat nechash nechoshet asher asa moshe"!
Amru lo: mishsham reaya? hare hu omer "vayyomer Adonai el moshe ase lecha saraf", "lecha" — mishshellecha, veen adam oser davar sheeno shello, vehatam bedin hu dechattote la hava tzerich.
Ella, kevan dachaza deka tau yisrael batreh, amad vechittato.

Amar lahem, vahalo kevar neemar: "vayyaazvu sham et atzabbehem vayyissaem david vaanashav", umay mashma dehay "vayyissaem david" lishshana dezaroye hu? kedimtargem rav yosef: "tizrem veruach tissaem", umetargeminan: tizrenun veruach tetaltelinnun.
Amru lo: mishsham reaya? hare hu omer "vayyissarfu baesh", umiddela ketiv "vayyisrefem vayyissaem", shema minna "vayyissaem" mammash.
Mikkol makom, kashu kerae ahadade.
Kidrav huna, derav huna rame: ketiv "vayyomer david vayyissarfu baesh", uchetiv "vayyissaem"!
La kashya, kan — kodem shebba ittay haggitti, kan — leachar shebba ittay haggitti.
Dichtiv: "vayyikkach et ateret malkam meal rosho umishkalah kikkar zahav", umi shere? issure hanaa ninhu! amar rav nachman: ittay haggitti ba uvittelah.

Mishkalah kikkar zahav, hechi matze mannach la? amar rav yehuda amar rav: reuya lanuach al rosh david. rabbi yose berabbi chanina amar: even shoevet hayta bah, dahavat dara la. rabbi elazar amar: even yekara hayta bah, sheshshava kikkar zahav.

"Zot hayta li ki fikkudecha natzarti" — may kaamar? hachi kaamar: bischar sheppikkudecha natzarti, zot hayta li leedut. may edutah? amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: shehaya mannichah bimkom tefillin veholamto. veha bae annoche tefillin! amar rabbi shemuel bar rav yitzchak: makom yesh barosh sherauy lehanniach bo shete tefillin.

"Vayyotziu et ben hammelech vayyittenu alav et hannezer veet haedut", "nezer" — zo kelila, "edut" — amar rav yehuda amar rav: edut hu levet david, shekkol harauy lammalchut holamto, vechol sheeno rauy lammalchut en holamto.
"Vaadoniyya ven chaggit mitnasse lemor ani emloch", amar rav yehuda amar rav: shemmitnasse leholmo velo holamto.
