"Vayyaas lo rechev ufarashim vachamishshim ish ratzim lefanav", may revutayyhu? tana: kullam netule techol vachakuke kappot haraglayim hayu.
b: Mishna shaal peroklus ben pelosfus et rabban gamliel beakko, shehaya rochetz bammerchatz shel afrodite. amar leh: katuv betoratchem "la yidbak beyadcha meuma min hacherem", mippene ma atta rochetz bemerchatz shel afrodite?
Amar lo: en meshivin bammerchatz. uchesheyyatza amar lo: ani lo bati bigvulah, hi baa bigvuli. en omrim: naasa merchatz noy leafrodite, ella omer: naasa afrodite noy lammerchatz.

Davar acher: im notnim lecha mamon harebe, i atta nichnas laavoda zara shellecha arom uvaal keri umashtin befaneha, zo omedet al pi habbiv vechol haam mashtinin lefaneha, lo neemar ella "elohehem" — et shennoheg bo mishshum eloah — asur, et sheeno noheg bo mishshum eloah — muttar.
Gemara vehechi aved hachi? vehaamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: bechol makom muttar lehareher, chutz mibbet hammerchatz umibbet hakkisse!
Vechi tema: bilshon chol amar leh, vehaamar abbaye: devarim shel chol muttar leomran bilshon kodesh, devarim shel kodesh asur leomran bilshon chol!
Tana: kesheyyatza, amar lo: en meshivin bammerchatz.
Amar rav chama bar yosef berabbi, amar rabbi oshaya: teshuva genuva heshivo rabban gamliel leoto hegmon, vaani omer: enah genuva.
Ma genuvetay? dekaamar lo: zo omedet al pi habbiv vechol adam mashtin befaneha. vechi mashtin befaneha may have? vehaamar rava: peor yochiach, shemmefaarin lefanav bechol yom veeno batel.
Vaani omer: enah genuva, zo avodatah bechach, vezo en avodatah bechach.

Amar abbaye: genuveta mehacha, dekaamar leh: ani lo bati bigvulah vehi baa bigvuli. vechi ba bigvulah may have? vehatnan: avoda zara sheyyesh lah merchatz o ginna — nehenin mehen shello betova, veen nehenin mehen betova.
Vaani omer: enah genuva, shello betovat rabban gamliel kivtovat acherim dame.

Rav shimi bar chiyyay amar: genuveta mehacha, dekaamar lo: zo omedet al habbiv vechol adam mashtinin befaneha. vechi mashtinin befaneha may have? vehatnan: rak befaneha, hishtin befaneha, gerra, vezarak bah et hatztzoa — hare zo enah betela.
Vaani omer: enah genuva, hatam — lefi shata hu ratach ala, vahadar mefayyes la, hacha — kol shata veshata bezilzula kayyma.

Rabba bar ulla amar: genuveta mehacha, dekaamar leh, en omrin: naasa merchatz noy leafrodite, ella: naasa afrodite noy lammerchatz; vechi amar "naasa merchatz leafrodite noy" may have? vehatanya: haomer "bayit ze laavoda zara", "kos ze laavoda zara" — lo amar kelum, sheen hekdesh laavoda zara.
Vaani omer: enah genuva, nehi deittesore la mittasra, noy miha ikka.

a: Mishna haggoyim haovdim et heharim veet haggevaot — hen muttarin, uma shealehen asurin, shenneemar: "lo tachmod kesef vezahav alehem".
Rabbi yose haggelili omer: "elohehem al heharim" — velo heharim elohehem, "elohehem al haggevaot" — velo haggevaot elohehem.
Umippene ma ashera asura? mippene sheyyesh bah tefisat yede adam, vechol sheyyesh bah tefisat yede adam — asur.
Amar rabbi akiva: ani ovin veadun lefanecha, kol makom sheatta motze har gavoah vegiva nissaa veetz raanan, da sheyyesh sham avoda zara.

Gemara verabbi yose haggelili hayeynu tanna kamma! amar rame bar chama amar resh lakish: tzippuy har kehar ikka benayyhu, tanna kamma savar: tzippuy har eno kehar umittesar, verabbi yose haggelili savar: tzippuy har hare hu kehar.
Rav sheshet amar: dechulle alma tzippuy har eno kehar.
b: Vehacha bailan shennetao ulevassof avado kamippalgi, tanna kamma savar: ilan shennetao ulevassof avado — muttar, verabbi yose haggelili savar: ilan shennetao ulevassof avado — asur.

Mimmay? middekatane sefa: mippene ma ashera asura? mippene sheyyesh bah tefisat yede adam, vechol sheyyesh bo tefisat yede adam asur. "vechol sheyyesh bo tefisat adam" leetoye may? lav leetoye ilan shennetao ulevassof avado?

Veaf rabbi yose berabbi yehuda savar: ilan shennetao ulevassof avado — asur, detanya: rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer, mittoch shenneemar: "elohehem al heharim" — velo heharim elohehem, "elohehem al haggevaot" — velo gevaot elohehem, shomea ani "tachat kol etz raanan elohehem" — velo raanan elohehem?
Talmud lomar: "vaasherehem tisrefun baesh".

Ella "tachat kol etz raanan" lema li? hahu lechidrabbi akiva hu daata, deamar rabbi akiva: ani ovin veadun lefanecha, kol makom sheatta motze har gavoah vegiva nissaa veetz raanan, da sheyyesh sham avoda zara.
Verabbanan, hay "vaasherehem tisrefun baesh" may avdi leh? mibbee leh leilan shennetao mittechilla lechach.

Verabbi yose berabbi yehuda name mibbee leh lehachi? hachi name. ella ilan shennetao ulevassof avado mena leh? nafka leh mivvaasherehem tegaddeun", ezehu etz sheggidduo asur veikkaro muttar? heve omer: ilan shennetao ulevassof avado.
Veha "vaasherehem tisrefun baesh" ka nasev la talmuda!

Illu lo neemar kaamar: illu lo neemar "tisrefun baesh", hayiti omer "asherehem tegaddeun" beilan shennetao mittechilla lechach, hasheta dichtiv "vaasherehem tisrefun baesh", iyyaytar leh "vaasherehem tegaddeun" leilan shennetao ulevassof avado.

Verabbanan, hay "vaasherehem tegaddeun" may avdi leh? lechidrabbi yehoshua ben levi, deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: giddue avoda zara kodmin lechibbush eretz yisrael, kibbush eretz yisrael kodem leviur avoda zara.
Detane rav yosef: "venittatztem et mizbechotam" vehannach, "veshibbartem et matztzevotam" vehannach.
Vehannach, salka datach? serefa bae! amar rav huna: redof, veachar kach serof.
Verabbi yose berabbi yehuda, hay sevara mena leh? nafka leh meabbed teabbedun" — "abbed", veachar kach "teabbedun".
Verabbanan? ha mibbee leh leoker avoda zara, shetztzarich lesharesh achareha.
Verabbi yose berabbi yehuda, lesharesh achareha mena leh? nafka leh mivveibbadtem et shemam min hammakom hahu".
Verabbanan? hahu lechannot lah shem, detanya: rabbi eliezer omer: minnayin leoker avoda zara shetztzarich lesharesh achareha? talmud lomar: "veibbadtem et shemam".

a: Amar lo rabbi akiva, vahalo kevar neemar: "abbed teabbedun", im ken ma talmud lomar: "veibbadtem et shemam min hammakom hahu"? lechannot lah shem.
Yachol leshevach? leshevach salka datach?! ella yachol lo leshevach velo lignay? talmud lomar: "shakketz teshakketzennu vetaev tetaavennu ki cherem hu".
Ha ketzad? hayu korin otah bet galya — korin otah "bet karya", pene melech — "pene kelev", en kol — "en kotz".
Tane tanna kammeh derav sheshet: haggoyim haovdim et heharim veet haggevaot — hen muttarin, veovdehen besayif, veet hazzeraim veet hayyerakot — hen asurin, veovdehen besayif.
Amar leh: deamar lach, manni? rabbi yose bar yehuda hi, deamar: ilan shennetao ulevassof avado — asur.
Velokma beilan shennetao mittechilla lechach, verabbanan! la salka datach, dekatane dumeya dehar, ma har shello netao mittechilla lechach, af hay name shello netao mittechilla lechach.

Ittemar: avne har shenniddaldelu — bene rabbi chiyyay verabbi yochanan, chad amar: asurot, vechad amar: muttarot. may tama deman deamar muttarot? kehar — ma har sheen bo tefisat yede adam umuttar, af hane sheen bahen tefisat yede adam umuttarin.
Ma lehar, shekken mechubbar! behema tochiach.
Ma livhema, shekken baalat chayyim! har yochiach.
Vechazar haddin, lo rei ze chiri ze, velo rei ze kiri ze, hatztzad hashshave shebbahen sheen bahen tefisat yede adam umuttar, af kol sheen bahen tefisat yede adam umuttar.
Ma lehatztzad hashshave shebbahen, shekken lo nishtannu mibberiyyaytan!
Ella atya mibbehema baalat mum, umehar.
Vei name, mibbehema tamma umeilan yavesh.
Uman deasar, lehachi ketiv "shakketz teshakketzennu vetaev tetaavennu", deaf al gav deatya middina lehettera, la tetya.
Tistayyem, divne rabbi chiyyay desharu, devae chizkiyya: zakaf betza lehishtachavot lah, mahu?
Ka salka datach lehishtachavot lah, vehishtachava lah, veka mibbaya leh hay zekifatah i have maase i la have maase, aval lo zakaf — la mittasra, shema minna bene rabbi chiyyay desharu.
La, leolam ema lach: bene rabbi chiyyay deasri, dehishtachava lah, af al gav delo zekafah asura, vehacha bemay askinan? kegon shezzakaf betza lehishtachavot lah, velo hishtachava lah.
Uleman? i leman deamar: avoda zara shel yisrael asura miyyad — asura, i leman deamar: ad shetteaved — ha la palcha!
La tzericha, kegon shezzakaf betza lehishtachavot lah, velo hishtachava lah, uva goy vehishtachava lah.

Ki ha deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: yisrael shezzakaf levena lehishtachavot lah, uva goy vehishtachava lah — asura. veka mibbaya leh: levena hu deminnachra zekifatah, aval betza — la? o dilma la shena? teku.
Bae rame bar chama: hammishtachave lehar, avanav mahu lammizbeach?
b: Yesh neevad bimchubbar etzel gavoah, o en neevad bimchubbar etzel gavoah?
Im timtze lomar yesh neevad bimchubbar etzel gavoah, machshire korban kekorban damu o la?

Amar rava, kal vachomer: uma etnan shemmuttar betalush lehedyot, asur bimchubbar legavoah, dichtiv: "lo tavi etnan zona umechir kelev", la shena talush vela shena bimchubbar, neevad sheasur betalush lehedyot — eno din sheasur bimchubbar legavoah?

Amar leh rav huna bereh derav yehoshua lerava: o chilluf, uma neevad sheasur betalush etzel hedyot — muttar bimchubbar legavoah, shenneemar: "elohehem al heharim" velo heharim elohehem, la shena lehedyot vela shena legavoah; etnan shemmuttar betalush lehedyot — eno din shemmuttar bimchubbar legavoah?
Vei mishshum "bet Adonai elohecha" mibbee leh lechidtanya: "bet Adonai elohecha" — perat lefara sheenah baa labbayit, divre rabbi eliezer. vachachamim omrim: lerabbot et harikkuim.
Amar leh: ana kaamena lechumera, veat amrat lekulla — kulla vechumera lechumera parchinan.

Amar leh rav pappa lerava: vechol hecha deikka kulla vechumera, lekulla la parchinan? veha hazzaa defesach, difligi rabbi eliezer verabbi akiva, derabbi eliezer savar lechumera veka mechayyev leh legavra, verabbi akiva lekulla ufatar, veka farech rabbi akiva lekulla!
Ditnan, heshiv rabbi akiva: o chilluf, uma hazzaa shehi mishshum shevut — enah docha [et] hashshabbat, shechita shehi deorayyta — lo kol shekken?

Hatam, rabbi eliezer gamreh, veiyyaykkar leh talmuda, vaata rabbi akiva leadkoreh. vehayeynu daamar leh: rabbi, al tachpireni bishat haddin, kach mekubbal ani mimmecha — hazzaa shevut, veenah docha et hashshabbat.
Bae rame bar chama: hammishtachave lekamat chittim, mahu limnachot? yesh shinnuy beneevad, o en shinnuy beneevad?
Amar mar zutera bereh derav nachman: ta shema, kol haasurin legabbe mizbeach — valdotehen muttarim, vetane ala: rabbi eliezer oser.
Velav ittemar ala, amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: machloket keshennirbeu ulevassof ibberu,

a: Aval ibberu ulevassof nirbeu — divre hakkol asurin, vehacha name keibberu ulevassof nirbeu dame.
Ikka deamri: machloket keshennirbeu ulevassof ibberu, aval ibberu ulevassof nirbeu — divre hakkol asur, vehane name ki ibberu ulevassof nirbeu dame.
Hachi hasheta? hatam, meikkara behema vehasheta behema, dashsha hu daachida beanpa. hacha, meikkara chitte vehasheta kimcha.
Bae resh lakish: hammishtachave laddekel, lulavo mahu lemitzva?
Beilan shennetao mittechilla lechach la tibbee lach, daafillu lehedyot name asur. ki tibbee lach beilan shennetao ulevassof avado.
Veallibba derabbi yose bar yehuda la tibbee lach, daafillu lehedyot name asur. ki tibbee lach allibba derabbanan, leinyan mitzva may? mi meis kelappe gavoah o la?
Ki ata rav dimi amar: baashera shebbittelah kamibbaya leh, yesh dichuy etzel mitzvot o en dichuy etzel mitzvot?

Tifshot leh midditnan: kissahu venitgalla — patur millechassot, kissahu haruach — chayyayv lechassot. veamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: lo shanu ella shechazar venitgalla, aval lo chazar venitgalla — patur millechassot.
Vehavenan bah: ki chazar venitgalla may have? hoil veiddechi iddechi!
Veamar rav pappa, zot omeret: en dichuy etzel mitzvot.
Derav pappa gufeh ibbaya leh, mifshat peshita leh lerav pappa deen dichuy etzel mitzvot, la shena lekulla vela shena lechumera.
O dilma sappoke mesappeka leh, ulechumera amrinan, lekulla la amrinan? teku.
Bae rav pappa: hammishtachave livhema, tzamrah mahu litchelet?
Techelet demay? i techelet lechohanim — hayeynu baya derame bar chama, vei techelet letzitzit — hayeynu baya deresh lakish!
In hachi name dela hava lemibbee leh, vehay deka vae leh ha mishshum deikka mille achranyayta: tzamrah mahu litchelet? karneha mahu lachatzotzrot? shokeha mahu lachalilin? bene meeha mahu leforot?
Allibba deman deamar: ikkar shira bichli, la tibbee lach — devadday asir.
Ki tibbee lach, allibba deman deamar: ikkar shira bappe, bassome kala bealma hu umayytinan, o dilma afillu hachi asir? teku.
Bae rabba: hammishtachave lemayan, memav mahu linsachim? may ka mibbaya leh? illema levavua ka saged, o dilma lemayya ka saged? vetibbee leh sefel lehedyot!
Leolam lemayya ka saged, vehachi kamibbaya leh: lemayya dekammeh ka saged, vekammae kammae azadu, o dilma ledavruna demayya ka saged?
Umi mittasri? veha amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yehotzadak: mayim shel rabbim en neesarin! la tzericha, deka navi meara.
Mishna mi shehaya beto samuch laavoda zara, venafal — asur livnoto. ketzad yaase? kones betoch shello arba ammot uvone.
Shello veshel avoda zara —
b: Niddon mechetza al mechetza.
Avanav, etzav vaafaro — metammein kesheretz, shenneemar: "shakketz teshakketzennu".
Rabbi akiva omer: kenidda, shenneemar: "tizrem kemo dava tze tomar lo", ma nidda metammea bemassa, af avoda zara metammea bemassa.
Gemara veha ka marvavch laavoda zara! amar rav chanina missura: deaved leh bet hakkisse.
Veha bae tzeniuta! deaved leh bet hakkisse delayla.
Veha amar mar: ezehu tzanua? hannifne ballayla bemakom shennifna bayyom, veaf al gav deokemna bichderech, mihu tzeniuta bae lemebad!
Deaved leh letinokot.
I name, degadayr leh behizme vehige.

Mishna shelosha battim hen — bayit shebbenao mittechilla laavoda zara, hare ze asur. siyyeydo vechiyyeydo laavoda zara vechiddesh — notel ma shechiddesh. hichnis letochah avoda zara vehotziah — hare ze muttar.
Gemara amar rav: hammishtachave levayit — asaro. alma kasavar talush ulevassof chibbero ketalush dame, vehaanan "benao" tenan!
Benao — af al pi shello hishtachava lo, hishtachava — af al pi shello benao. i hachi, hane shelosha — arbaa havu!
Kevan dilinyan bittul, bana vehishtachava chad ka chashev leh.

Mishna shalosh avanim hen — even shechatzavah mittechilla levimos — hare zo asura. siyyeydah vechiyyeydah leshem avoda zara — notel ma shessiyyed vechiyyed, umutteret. heemid aleha avoda zara vesillekah — hare zo mutteret.
Gemara amar rabbi amme: vehu shessiyyed vechiyyed begufah shel even.
Veha duvmya devayit tenan, uvayit lav begufeh hu, umittesar! bayit name ikka bene ureve.
Mi la askinan deshiya, vahadar shayyeh?
Ella ki ittemar derabbi amme — leinyan bittul ittemar, veaf al gav desiyyed vechiyyed begufah shel even, ki natal ma shechiddesh — shappir dame.
Demahu detema: kevan shessiyyed vechiyyed begufah shel even, keeven shechatzavah mittechilla laavoda zara damya, vetittesar kulla, ka mashma lan.

a: Mishna shalosh asherot hen — ilan shennetao mittechilla leshem avoda zara, hare zo asura. giddeo ufisselo leshem avoda zara vehechlif — notel ma shehechlif. heemid tachteha avoda zara unetalah — hare zo mutteret.
Gemara amri deve rabbi yannay: vehu shehivrich vehirkiv begufo shel ilan.
Vehaanan "giddeo ufisselo" tenan!

Ella ki ittemar derabbi yannay, leinyan bittul ittemar, deaf al gav dehivrich vehirkiv begufo shel ilan, ki natal ma shehechlif — shappir dame, demahu detema: kevan dehivrich vehirkiv begufo shel ilan keilan shennetao mittechilla dame, velittesar kulla, ka mashma lan.
Amar shemuel: hammishtachave leilan, (tosefteh) [tosafto] asura. metiv rabbi elazar: giddeo ufisselo laavoda zara vehechlif — notel ma shehechlif. giddeo ufisselo — in, lo giddeo ufisselo — lo!
Amar lecha shemuel: ha manni? rabbanan hi, ushemuel deamar kerabbi yose bar yehuda, deamar: ilan shennetao ulevassof avado — asur.
Matkef la rav ashe: mimmay derabbi yose bar yehuda verabbanan betosefet peligi? dilma tosefet ledivre hakkol asur, uveikkaro peligi.

Derabbi yose bar yehuda savar: ikkaro name asur, dichtiv: "vaasherehem tisrefun baesh", verabbanan savri: ikkar ilan shere, dichtiv: "vaasherehem tegaddeun". ezehu ilan sheggidduo asur veikkaro shere? heve omer: ilan shennetao ulevassof avado!
Vechi tema: ha dela metartzinan hachi — efoch rabbanan lidrabbi yose bar yehuda, uderabbi yose bar yehuda lerabbanan!
Im ken, giddeo ufisselo, man katane la? la rabbanan vela rabbi yose bar yehuda! i rabbanan — belo giddeo ufisselo name tosefet asura, i rabbi yose bar yehuda — ikkar ilan name asur!

I baet ema rabbanan, vei baet ema rabbi yose bar yehuda. i baet ema rabbi yose bar yehuda — ki kaamar rabbi yose bar yehuda belo giddeo ufisselo ikkar ilan asur bistama, aval giddeo ufisselo — galli addateh divtosefet nicha leh, beikkar ilan la nicha leh.
Ibbaet ema: rabbanan, "giddeo ufisselo" itztericha leh. salka datach amena: kevan daavad leh maase begufeh, ikkar ilan name littesar, kamashma lan.

Mishna ezo ashera? kol sheyyesh tachteha avoda zara. rabbi shimon omer: kol sheovdin otah. umaase betzaydan beilan shehayu ovdin oto, umatzu tachtav gal. amar lahen rabbi shimon: bidku et haggal hazze, uvedakuhu umatzu bo tzura. amar lahen: hoil velatztzura hen ovdin, nattir lahen et hailan.

Gemara ezehu ashera? veha anan "shalosh asherot" tenan! hachi kaamar: shetayim ledivre hakkol, veachat machloket derabbi shimon verabbanan. ezo hi ashera shennechleku bah rabbi shimon vachachamim? kol sheyyesh tachteha avoda zara, rabbi shimon omer: kol sheovdim otah.

Ezo hi ashera setam? amar rav: kol shekkomarim yoshvin tachteha veen toamin mipperoteha. ushemuel amar: afillu amri "hane tamre leve nitzrefe" — asur, derame be shichra veshate leh beyom edam. amar ammemar: amaru li save defumebdita hilcheta kishmuel.
b: Mishna lo yeshev betzillah, veim yashav — tahor, velo yaavor tachteha, veim avar — tame. hayta gozelet et harabbim veavar tachteha — tahor.
Gemara lo yeshev betzillah. peshita! amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: lo nitzrecha ella letzel tzillah.
Mikkelal divtzel komatah, im yashav — tame? lo, daafillu letzel komatah name, im yashav — tahor, veha ka mashma lan, daafillu letzel tzillah lo yeshev.

Ikka dematne la assefa, veim yashav tahor. peshita? amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: lo nitzrecha ella letzel komatah. mikkelal diltzel tzillah afillu lechattechilla yeshev? la, ha ka mashma lan, daafillu letzel komatah im yashav — tahor.
Velo yaavor tachteha, veim avar — tame. may tama? i efshar delekka tikrovet avoda zara.

Manni? rabbi yehuda ben betera hi, detanya: rabbi yehuda ben betira omer: minnayin letikrovet avoda zara shemmetammea beohel? shenneemar: "vayyitztzamdu levaal peor vayyochlu zivche metim" — ma met metamme beohel, af tikrovet avoda zara metamme beohel.
Hayta gozelet et harabbim veavar tachteha — tahor. ibbaya lehu: avar o over? rabbi yitzchak ben elazar mishshemeh dechizkiyya amar: over, verabbi yochanan amar: im avar.
Vela peligi, ha deikka dirka acharina, ha delekka dirka acharina.
Amar leh rav sheshet leshammaeh: ki matet lehatam "arhetni". hechi dame? i delekka dirka acharina, lema li "arhetni"? mishra shere! vei deikka dirka achrina, ki amar "arhetni" mi shere?
Leolam, delekka dirka acharina, veadam chashuv shane.

Mishna zorin tachteha yerakot bimot haggeshamim, aval lo bimot hachamma, vehachazerin lo bimot hachamma velo bimot haggeshamim. rabbi yose omer: af lo yerakot bimot haggeshamim, mippene shehanneviyya nosheret alehen vehova lahen lezevel.
Gemara lememra derabbi yose savar: ze vaze gorem — asur, verabbanan amri: ze vaze gorem — muttar?
Ha ippecha shaminan lehu, ditnan: rabbi yose omer: shochek vezore laruach o metil layyam. amru lo: af hi naasa zevel, veneemar: "lo yidbak beyadcha meuma min hacherem".
Kashya derabbanan adderabbanan, kashya derabbi yose adderabbi yose!
Bishlama derabbi yose adderabbi yose la kashya: hatam, dekaazel leibbud — mattir, hacha, dela kaazel leibbud — asur.
Ella derabbanan adderabbanan kashya, efoch.
Veibbaet ema: la tefoch, derabbi yose kidshannin, derabbanan kidamar rav mari bereh derav kahana: ma shemmashbiach baor — pogem babbasar.
Hacha name, ma shemmashbiach banneviyya, pogem batztzel.

Vesavar rabbi yose ze vaze gorem asur? vehatanya: rabbi yose omer: notin yichur shel orla, veen notin egoz shel orla, mippene shehu peri. veamar rav yehuda amar rav: mode rabbi yose sheim nata vehivrich vehirkiv — muttar.
Vetanya name hachi: mode rabbi yose
